### Replacing brake fluid

1. Remove the engine trim panel assembly. Refer to: Engine trim panel assembly

2. Replacing brake fluid

a. Remove the cover of brake fluid reservoir.
b. Pump out the old brake fluid from the brake fluid reservoir.

i Caution: A small amount of brake fluid should be kept in the brake fluid reservoir to prevent air from entering the brake pipeline.

c. Remove the rear left wheel assembly. Refer to: Wheel assembly d. Open the dust cover of the exhaust port.

![](images/7864bd256b9d33d2be637b8c0a47b8f2bf8ccf28ded53341919a0805002f2afc.webp)

![](images/192df462ab219ca2ab2a08cf09f1230e90ec5e257a6404d3cd1462547dd27a92.webp)

e. Insert a wrench and install the transparent hose of the exhaust bottle on the exhaust port.

f. Loosen the exhaust screw, ask an assistant to depress the brake pedal to the lowest position until the brake fluid no longer flows out, then tighten the exhaust screw and release the brake pedal.

g. Repeat the previous step until clear brake fluid flows out.

i Caution: During discharge of brake fluid, add brake fluid into the brake fluid reservoir continuously to prevent the brake fluid level from falling below the "MIN" mark.

h. Pull out the transparent hose (brake fluid collection bottle end), put it into a clean container, loosen the exhaust screw, take a small amount of brake fluid, and then tighten the exhaust screw.
i. Detect the water content of brake fluid with a brake fluid detector. If the measured result shows that there is no water in the brake fluid, this round of brake fluid replacement is completed.
j. Connect the transparent hose to the brake fluid collection bottle.
k. After continuously depressing the brake pedal for several times, keep the brake pedal depressed, loosen the exhaust screw, observe that no bubble emerges from the brake fluid collection bottle, and then tighten the exhaust screw. Torque: 12±2N•m
l. Repeat the previous step for 3\~4 times to confirm that there is no air in the brake system.
m. Pull out the transparent hose, remove the wrench, and install the dust cover of exhaust port.
n. Install the rear left wheel assembly. Refer to: Wheel assembly

![](images/bba258a6e1e4c935af9474e0a96f8aeb2873a844fbfcc2529832112e5dabc171.webp)

o. Perform the above operations on each wheel in the order shown.

### i Caution:

When a single brake caliper has two bleed holes (bleed screws), brake fluid replacement is required for both bleed holes.

p. Remove the excess brake fluid in the reservoir to ensure that the maximum fluid level is at the “MAX” mark.

q. Clean the spilled brake fluid.
r. Install the cover of brake fluid reservoir.

3. Install the engine trim panel assembly. Refer to: Engine trim panel assembly

### 1. Warnings for disconnecting cathode of 12V battery (starter Fe battery)

a. Please confirm that the vehicle is moved to the special maintenance station for new energy vehicle, and place a high-voltage warning sign and isolation strip.
b. Turn off all electrical loads and power off the vehicle, unless otherwise stated in the operating procedures.
c. Follow the standard procedure for disabling high-voltage power before repairing high-voltage components. Refer to: High Voltage Power Disable and Enable

### 2. Warnings for maintenance of high-voltage system

a. Non-professional personnel shall not repair and replace high-voltage system components.
b. Maintenance technicians, who have not received high-voltage safety training, shall not maintain and operate high-voltage components.
c. Do not maintain or replace high-voltage components during charging.
d. Before operating high-voltage components, be sure to disconnect the charging port from the charging equipment and ensure that the vehicle is powered off.
e. Wear insulating protective equipment, such as insulating gloves, insulating shoes, goggles.
f. After disconnecting the connector of high-voltage component, measure its voltage with a multimeter, and proceed to the next step only when the voltage drops below the safe voltage.
g. When repairing high-voltage components, pay attention to the shell surface temperature, and operate after cooling.
h. When measuring insulation resistance, do not touch exposed conductive parts; otherwise electric shock may occur.
i. Do not repair vehicles in corrosive, flammable and explosive gas environment; otherwise fire and explosion may occur.
j. Do not disassemble or modify the high-voltage components without permission; otherwise it will cause the high-voltage components to fail to work normally and may lead to dangerous accidents.
k. After removing the high-voltage wiring harness, pay attention to the insulation protection of the high-voltage wiring harness and the interface of high-voltage components.

### 3. Warnings for road test

a. Perform a road test on the vehicle by professionals on the premise of ensuring safety and complying with all traffic regulations.
b. Do not try any operation that may endanger the control over the vehicle.
c. Violation against the above safety instructions will result in serious personal injury or vehicle damage.

### 1. System Overview

a. The charging and distribution system is mainly composed of the charging and distribution assembly, integrated AC/DC charging vehicle socket sub-assembly, charging equipment, high voltage battery pack, high-voltage wiring harness, instrument cluster and charging port indicator etc.

### 2. Main functions

a. AC charging (power: 7kW).

AC charging is to charge the vehicle through household charging equipment (that is, the AC charging connector provided by the vehicle) or charging equipment of charging pile (that is, the AC charging connector provided by the charging pile).
Convert AC to DC to charge the high voltage battery pack. When the pack is fully charged, the system automatically stops charging.

b. DC charging (power: 110kW).

DC charging means that the charging equipment of charging pile (that is, the DC charging connector provided by the charging pile) charges the vehicle in DC charging mode. When charging the vehicle in DC mode, the DC charging contactor inside the charging and distribution assembly is closed to charge the high voltage battery pack. When the pack is fully charged, the system automatically stops charging.

c. DC-DC function.

After the vehicle is powered on, the high voltage DC of the high voltage battery pack is converted into low voltage DC (about 13.8V) through the DC-DC converter of the charging and distribution assembly, which supplies power to the low-voltage apparatus of the vehicle and also charges the 12V battery (starter Fe battery).

d. Distribution of high voltage power supply.

The charging and distribution assembly is directly connected with the high voltage battery pack through the high-voltage wiring harness. The high voltage DC passes through the fuse inside the charging and distribution assembly, and the high-voltage power is distributed to the front A/C PTC air heater assembly, DC-DC converter, battery heater, electric compressor and front drive electric powertrain.

e. Electric leakage detection

There is an electric leakage sensor inside the charging and distribution assembly to detect the insulation resistance between HV+/HV- and grounding at all times.

### CCS communication controller(EVCC(Electric Vehicle Communication Controller))

1. EVCC is used for DC charging. During vehicle charging, it can communicate with the vehicle battery management system and the communication controller at the end of charging pile at the same time, and covert the CAN communication into the PLC communication required for DC charging.

### Charging cables (AC charging)

1. 10A household charging cable for Mode 2， Resistance in charging cable is 680Ω.
2. 32A Charging cable for Mode 3,Resistance in charging cable is 220Ω.

### 3.1.7.2 DTC reading and clearing

Use VDS to read and clear the vehicle fault codes, and determine the current DTC to help maintenance personnel to test quickly.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module” → “Charging and Distribution Assembly(BYD)”

6. Read and clear the DTC.

a. Select “Fault detection” to read DTC.
b. Select “Clear fault” to clear DTC.

![](images/072b1c95609f5ec1ab1a533e54771870664e3117236d52c6384e196b3c589d1f.webp)

### Read data flow

According to the display on VDS, read the data flow of the current system, and read the working state information of the charging and distribution assembly without disassembling any parts. Reading the data flow first when troubleshooting can improve work efficiency.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module” → “Charging and Distribution Assembly(BYD)”

6. Read data flow.

a. Select “Data flow” to read the data flow.

Follow the above diagnostic steps and check again.

### Check the charging port

1. Check the charging port

a. Power off the vehicle and unlock it, open the charging port hatch, and remove the charging port protection cover.
b. Visually check the appearance of the plastic insulated housing of the charging port for deformation due to hot melting, and replace relevant part in case of serious deformation that affects normal use.
c. Visually check the inside of the charging port and terminal for foreign objects. Remove foreign objects (if any) with a high pressure pneumatic gun. Replace relevant part if any foreign object cannot be removed and affects normal use.
d. Visually check whether the plastic protective cap of the charging port terminal melts and falls off, and replace it if so.
e. Visually check the charging port terminal for copper leakage or yellowing. If so, please check whether the cable at the tail of the charging port becomes black and deformed. If there is copper leakage and yellowing and the outer layer of the cable at the tail becomes black, replacement is required.
f. Visually check whether the terminal is bent or deformed. If one side of the terminal is seriously worn, deformed and ablated, replacement is required.
g. Replace any charging port beyond the quality warranty period at your own expense (if it is not replaced, inform the user of potential safety hazards and associated loss to the charging plug).

### Basic inspection steps

1. Check the charging pile.

a. Replace the charging pile for DC charging, and check whether it is faulty.

2. Check the charging port

a. Check whether there is any foreign matter inside the charging port.
b. Check the charging port terminal reed for wear, aging, deformation, fracture and ablation.

### 3. Check the charger lock.

a. Perform action test for the charger lock. Refer to: Action test. Visually check whether the unlocking and locking of the charger lock work normally.

![](images/726d1c608dbcad31e4f4e93b66ba4915756bed7d5c24498128d81dd863da8599.webp)

b. Check the charger lock fuse. Standard value: F8/14(10A)

![](images/74fcd81415ad40153842519d25b268db3890d3045669dca2de414a446f64d4a3.webp)

c. Check the unlocking/locking control wiring harness of charger lock.

When the vehicle is OFF, disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). Disconnect the low-voltage wiring harness connector K50 of integrated AC/DC charging vehicle socket sub- assembly and the connector K8B of rear compartment distribution box port B.
Measure the resistance between the terminals 4/5 of K50 and terminals 10/12 of K8B with a digital multimeter.

Resistance value: <1Ω

![](images/017b9eef58d3d764beb9305c32bc163525d2a22123a5f570e208cddd526069f3.webp)

d. Check the unlocking/locking feedback wiring harness of charger lock. When the vehicle is OFF, disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). Disconnect the low-voltage wiring harness connector K50 of integrated AC/DC charging vehicle socket sub-assembly and the connector G64E of integrated vehicle body controller port E. Measure the resistance between the terminal 6 of K50 and terminal 9 of G64E with a digital multimeter.

Resistance value: <1Ω

![](images/1f6ce53832cd7a48d8630f98947f6b60182eb955aae258bf1da79f7af28748f0.webp)

### 4. CCS communication converter

e. Check the charger lock.

Connect the control wiring harness at both ends of the charger lock to 12V power supply, and check the working condition of the charger lock.

![](images/8b109543a9687d86fabbe4dd36fd4afdf1e049cf40731b91f8d0ad4d4c67d052.webp)

a. Check the CCS communication converter fuse. Standard value: F1/35(5A)

![](images/18cfb71eb1d2b9f077607885b9b8bad82af6eefc5d84ce0035737a45d5a5eb24.webp)

b. Check the GND wiring harness of CCS communication converter. When the vehicle is OFF, disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). Disconnect the wiring harness connector KB77 of CCS communication converter. Measure the resistance between the terminals 11/20 of KB77 and GND with a digital multimeter.

### Resistance value: <1Ω

c. Check the power supply voltage of CCS communication converter. Connect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) and start the vehicle. Measure the voltage between the terminals 11/ 20 of KB77 and GND with a digital multimeter.

Voltage: 11\~14V

![](images/705c3a8c35e583cb7b572a6b31b85fbe720b8963f7ed0474044561cc46e86b69.webp)

d. Check the DC charging CAN wiring harness.

When the vehicle is OFF, disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). Disconnect the wiring harness connector KB77 of CCS communication converter and the lowvoltage wiring harness connector B72 of high voltage battery pack.
Measure the resistance between the terminals 8/18 of KB77 and terminals 8/15 of B72 with a digital multimeter.

### 1. Preparations

a. Drive the vehicle into the lifting position, activate the parking brake, and power off the vehicle.

2. Remove the engine trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Engine trimming panel assembly
3. Remove the front left/right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly
4. Remove the grille upper cover assembly. Refer to: Grille upper cover assembly
5. Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). Refer to: Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery)
6. Drain coolant from the motor cooling system. Refer to: Replace coolant (cooling system)
7. Remove the charging and distribution assembly.

![](images/f48e62939885e3f9e9c50ddf94470700ae4ab0cfa79f23a0012104d069d029cc.webp)

a. Disconnect the connector of HV distribution wiring harness sub-assembly ①.

### 0 Tip:

Toggle the connector latch backward, gently shake the connector, then slowly lift the handle by hand, and pull out the connector backward at the same time.

### i Caution:

Protect the plugs of charging and distribution assembly and HV distribution wiring harness sub-assembly with special tools. Refer to: High voltage power disable and enable

### . Warning:

Disconnect the HV distribution wiring harness sub-assembly for 5min before performing subsequent operations.

Special tool: protective covers for battery anode and cathode lead wires (high-voltage power-off operation) Special tool: insulating lock Special tool: protective cover for charging and distribution assembly (high-voltage power-off operation) b. Disconnect the low-voltage wiring harness connector ②.

c. Disconnect the connector ③ of integrated AC/DC charging vehicle socket sub-assembly.
d. Disconnect the connector ④ of HV load wiring harness sub-assembly.
e. Disconnect the connector ⑤ of A/C compressor wiring harness sub-assembly.
f. Disconnect the connector ⑥ of battery heater assembly.

### i Caution:

Note that there are secondary lock structures in ④, ⑤ and ⑥.

![](images/ebbb5d2e6aa040c7f8159610f81fb09b780b6fde9ea61cb8a06ce92337a02ec7.webp)

g. Remove the elastic clamp A, disconnect the coolant pipe assembly 51①, and disengage the pipeline fixing clip.
h. Remove the fixing bolt B and take off the ground wire ② Torque: 22±2 N•m
i. Remove the fixing bolt C and take off the ground wire ③. Torque: 22±2 N•m

![](images/d3125491ddc7c051bd0513bac8bb4f397bea7a3d11523ea962c4785318c3bc97.webp)

j. Remove the elastic clamp A and disconnect the coolant pipe assembly 21①.
k. Remove the elastic clamp B and disconnect the coolant pipe assembly 61②.

![](images/5d68a6c7cfb0ad3c0b937e3d8673bedf626a783670bfaebbb815400ee20570e4.webp)

l. Remove the 21 fixing bolts A and 2 anti-removal bolts B, and take off the upper cover of charging and distribution assembly. Special tool: removal and installation tool for anti-removal bolt Torque: 3.5±0.3N m

![](images/529fb91b9c7ecdda8304dc4337319709ae99fa8f59607bb35b852ffb7589f187.webp)

m. Remove the 4 fixing bolts A and take off the integrated AC/DC charging vehicle socket subassembly ①.

Torque: 9±2 N•m

n. Remove the 4 fixing bolts B, and take off the HV wiring harness ② of front drive electric powertrain. Torque: 9±2 N•m

o. Remove the 4 fixing bolts A and 2 fixing bolts B, and take off the motor N wire ①. Torque: 9±2 N•m

![](images/2e1050a530d5ff62ce87d26228f5c2253df163d4e549dfd97a3f097f229ef02b.webp)

p. Open the protective cover for the DC output cable, remove one fixing nut, and take off the DC output cable.

Torque: 22±2 N•m

q. Remove all fixing clips connected to the charging and distribution assembly.

r. Remove the 4 fixing bolts of the charging and distribution assembly and take out the charging and distribution assembly.

Torque: 22±2 N•m

### Installation procedures

1. Install the charging and distribution assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

a. All high voltage wiring harness connectors should be firmly locked with secondary locks. b. Replace the damaged fixing clips, and fix all wiring harnesses and coolant pipes firmly. c. Add coolant of motor cooling system. Refer to: Replace coolant (cooling system)

d. After installation, start the vehicle and check that the charging and distribution assembly should work properly.

2. Remove the engine trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Engine trimming panel assembly

3. Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). Refer to: Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery)

4. Disable the high voltage power. Refer to: High voltage power disable and enable

5. Remove the front motor lower mudguard assembly. Refer to: Front motor lower mudguard assembly

6. Remove the A/C compressor wiring harness sub-assembly.

### i Caution:

c. Remove all wiring harness fixing clips of A/C compressor wiring harness sub-assembly, and take off the A/C compressor wiring harness sub-assembly.

a. The connector should lock the secondary lock firmly.

### 3.2.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. Do not open the auxiliary coolant tank cover in the warm-up state. If doing it, the hightemperature coolant or vapour may spray out and cause personal injury. The auxiliary coolant tank cover can not be opened until the coolant temperature drops below 40℃.

2. When disconnecting the cooling system pipeline, be sure to collect residual coolant with a special container.

3. Coolant is toxic. If not used any more, be sure to keep it away from children and pets, and dispose it as required.

4. When disconnecting the cooling system pipeline, do not let debris enter the cooling system pipeline; otherwise it may damage the cooling system.

5. When disconnecting the connector of cooling system pipeline, the nozzle can be sealed with a plug cap in order to prevent dirt or impurities from entering.

6. When replacing the coolant, it is necessary to lay a rag in the front compartment to absorb the spilled coolant.

7. Different brands of coolant are formulated differently. In case of mixed use, chemical reactions between various additives are likely to occur, resulting in coolant failure.

8. When draining and filling coolant, be sure to take protective measures to prevent the coolant from polluting parts.

9. Drain the old coolant during replacement, clean the cooling system, and then add new coolant.

10.Use qualified coolant.

11.When the temperature is below 0℃, check the freezing point of coolant regularly.

### 1. Coolant flow direction of motor cooling system

a. The motor cooling system is composed of auxiliary coolant tank assembly, high-temperature radiator assembly, charging and distribution assembly, electric coolant pump assembly I, front drive electric powertrain and rear drive electric powertrain, etc. b. After the vehicle is started, the vehicle controller controls the operation of electric coolant pump assembly I , driving the coolant to pass through the charging and distribution assembly, then enter the front drive electric powertrain, the rear drive electric powertrain and the hightemperature radiator assembly, and then return to the electric coolant pump assembly to form a circulation loop for cooling.

### Check the coolant level.

1. Check the coolant level.

a. Remove the front right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly

![](images/e25983b306722737cbeef8a2e703502a72aa020b25a03015dae15f149d7a2e53.webp)

### Check auxiliary coolant tank cover

1. Check auxiliary coolant tank cover b. Observe the coolant level in the auxiliary coolant tank assembly. Make sure that the coolant level is between the "MIN" and "MAX" marks. c. If the coolant level is at or below the "MIN" mark, add coolant to the auxiliary coolant tank assembly until coolant reaches "MAX" mark and check if the cooling system is subject to leakage.

a. Remove the front right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly
b. Remove the auxiliary coolant tank cover.
c. Wet the seal ring of the auxiliary coolant tank cover with coolant.

![](images/2e127a3da33cc00199d824d9a3adaac99ae1e297c4c8820e45af4a3128307071.webp)

d. Install the auxiliary coolant tank cover on the pressure test tool for cooling system. Special tool: pressure test tool for cooling system

e. Apply a pressure in the range of 15kPa～45kPa.

f. Check whether pressure drop occurs.

0 Tip: In case of pressure drop, the auxiliary water tank cover should be replaced.

g. Install the auxiliary coolant tank cover.
h. Install the front right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly

### Check the cooling system.

1. Check whether there is a leakage in the cooling system.

a. Remove the front right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly
b. Remove the auxiliary coolant tank cover.
c. Fill the coolant between "MIN" mark and "MAX” mark.

![](images/c86204a705ccca77ffc652d81d83a03859a3a1de52a3384694d2c76849e8752d.webp)

d. Install the pressure test tool for cooling system to the filler port of the auxiliary coolant tank assembly. Special tool: pressure test tool for cooling system

e. Apply a pressure in the range of 15kPa～45kPa.

f. Check whether coolant leaks or pressure of cooling system drops.

i Caution: If the pressure of cooling system drops, which indicates that there is a leakage point in the system, check and repair the system.

g. Remove the pressure test tool for cooling system and install the auxiliary coolant tank cover. h. Install the front right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly

### 1. Preparations

a. Drive the vehicle into the lifting position, activate the parking brake, and power off the vehicle.

2. Remove the front motor lower mudguard assembly. Refer to: Front motor lower mudguard assembly

3. Remove the front right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly

### 4. Drain the coolant

a. Remove the auxiliary coolant tank cover.

i Caution:

After the drive motor and auxiliary coolant tank are completely cooled, remove the auxiliary coolant tank cover.

0 Tip:

Turn the auxiliary coolant tank cover counterclockwise slowly (do not press it down) until it removed. Such slow operation can gradually relieve residual pressure in the cooling system.

![](images/c963e2794ca059caf2d1bf8952cb6db06392ebebfcece00d5a8a9c16b7130d23.webp)

b. Remove the elastic clamp, pull out the coolant pipe assembly 51①, and recycle the waste coolant.

i Caution:

Recycle the waste coolant according to local regulations.

c. After the coolant is drained, install the coolant pipe assembly 51① and fix it with elastic clamps.

### 5. Add coolant

Coolant capacity of motor cooling system: 9.3±0.2L Coolant specification of motor cooling system①: -40℃ long-acting organic acid coolant Coolant specification of motor cooling system②: Arteco Havoline XLC50_50

a. Fill in the auxiliary coolant tank with the coolant, until reaching the “MAX” mark b. Start the vehicle, and power it off after the coolant pump runs for about 5min.

0 Tip: Fill the auxiliary coolant tank with coolant continuously until the coolant level is between "MIN” mark and "MAX" mark and does not change. c. Start the vehicle again and check the motor cooling system for any leakage. d. Install the auxiliary coolant tank cover and fasten it.

6. Clear spilled coolant

7. Install the front motor lower mudguard assembly. Refer to: Front motor lower mudguard assembly
8. Install the front right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly

### 3.3.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. Do not open the auxiliary coolant tank cover of battery thermal management system in the warm-up state. If doing it, the high-temperature coolant or vapour may spray out and cause personal injury. The auxiliary coolant tank cover of battery thermal management system can not be opened until the coolant temperature drops below 40℃.

2. When disconnecting the cooling system pipeline, be sure to collect residual coolant with a special container.

3. Coolant is toxic. If not used any more, be sure to keep it away from children and pets, and dispose it as required.

4. When disconnecting the cooling system pipeline, do not let debris enter the cooling system pipeline; otherwise it may damage the cooling system.

5. When disconnecting the connector of cooling system pipeline, the nozzle can be sealed with a plug cap in order to prevent dirt or impurities from entering.

6. Different brands of coolant are formulated differently. In case of mixed use, chemical reactions between various additives are likely to occur, resulting in coolant failure.

7. When draining and filling coolant, be sure to take protective measures to prevent the coolant from polluting parts.

8. Drain the old coolant during replacement, clean the battery temperature control system, and then add new coolant.

9. Use qualified coolant.

10.When the temperature is below 0℃, check the freezing point of coolant regularly.

### 1. System Overview

a. The battery temperature control system is mainly composed of coolant pump assembly of battery thermal management system, battery cooling plate heat exchanger assembly, battery heater assembly, high voltage battery pack, auxiliary coolant tank assembly of battery thermal management system and cooling pipeline (including battery pack coolant outlet temperature sensor).

### 2. Main functions

a. Cooling high voltage battery pack.

When the temperature of high voltage battery pack is high, the A/C electric compressor works, and the refrigerant enters the battery cooling plate heat exchanger assembly to exchange heat with the coolant and cool the coolant, and then enters the high voltage battery pack and cools it under the action of the coolant pump of battery thermal management system.

b. Charging heating：

![](images/0ef47e9d782f94b0e91767d99dcc4e62601234c7da00a3ccbec9bab2f7efc590.webp)

c. Driving heating.

Normal heating： SOC and battery cell temperature (T) meet the strategy. Such as SOC= 50% and T= -10℃ , SOC=60% and T= -20℃.
Special situation heating： Voltage difference between cell maximum voltage and minimum voltage is more than 0.15V, heating start, which contributes to good battery performance.

### 3.3.7.2 DTC reading and clearing

Use VDS to read and clear the vehicle fault codes, and determine the current DTC to help maintenance personnel to test quickly.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New
Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module” → “Battery heater(BYD)”
6. Read and clear the DTC.

![](images/3679fba7fa57ccb67eace365a7db30ac620fa4b3cf5b84143aa745538002c318.webp)

a. Select “Fault detection” to read DTC.
b. Select “Clear fault” to clear DTC.

### Read data flow

According to the display on VDS, read the data flow of the current system, and read the working state information of the battery heater without disassembling any parts. Reading the data flow first when troubleshooting can improve work efficiency.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New
Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” “ECU module” → “Battery heater(BYD)”
6. Read data flow

a. Select “Data flow” to read the data flow.

d. Connect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) and start the vehicle.
e. Measure the voltage between the terminal 1 of B77 and GND with a digital multimeter. Voltage:

![](images/05b0b9597a6afb334c5e7c354eb984f73819dafe51da2c9b9f2907dd70cf8924.webp)

f. Check whether the result is normal?

Repair or replace the power supply wiring harness of battery heater.

Yes

![](images/aaddc60cfe096dd99365f3fe4e03bd68b5aa70a11d033f9ee49a095b8f66537e.webp)

a. Replace the battery heater with a new one. b. Restore the vehicle, clear all module fault codes, and perform the test drive for functional inspection. c. Check whether the result is normal?

Troubleshooting.

![](images/ff5aacbf350df735119e25fca6e16b0e0dd90b1063750aa6831c38f3b483742d.webp)

a. Replace the charging and distribution assembly with a new one.
b. Restore the vehicle, clear all module fault codes, and perform the test drive for functional inspection.
c. Check whether the result is normal?

Follow the above diagnostic steps and check again.

### Check the level of battery temperature control system coolant

1. Check the level of battery temperature control system coolant a. Remove the engine trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Engine trimming panel assembly b. Remove the front right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly

![](images/9a23b806300e286dca6729b5d7c2ff6834246d299cd3c7b19dd4d592a2d722a4.webp)

c. Observe the coolant level in the battery thermal management auxiliary coolant tank assembly. Make sure that the coolant level is between the "MIN" and "MAX" marks. d. If the coolant level is at or below the "MIN" mark, add coolant to the battery thermal management auxiliary coolant tank assembly until coolant reaches "MAX" mark and check if the battery temperature control system is subject to leakage.

### Check auxiliary coolant tank cover of battery thermal management system

1. Check auxiliary coolant tank cover of battery thermal management system

a. Remove the front right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly
b. Remove the battery thermal management auxiliary coolant tank cover.
c. Wet the seal ring of the auxiliary coolant tank cover of battery thermal management system with coolant.

![](images/fe493d039e8409a159516adea1264a271f109666a39355f2d3622ff601b760de.webp)

d. Install the auxiliary coolant tank cover of battery thermal management system on the pressure test tool for cooling system. Special tool: pressure test tool for cooling system

e. Apply a pressure in the range of 15kPa～45kPa.
f. Check whether pressure drop occurs.

### 0 Tip:

If the pressure drops, replace the auxiliary coolant tank cover of battery thermal management system.

g. Install the auxiliary coolant tank cover of battery thermal management system. h. Install the front right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly

### Check battery temperature control system

1. Check the battery temperature control system for any leakage.

a. Remove the front right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly
b. Remove the battery thermal management auxiliary coolant tank cover.
c. Fill the coolant between "MIN" mark and "MAX” mark.

![](images/b49e7bcacc62407566b069ba55fb01a0660c2d406423409d418cf6e9602bcc5a.webp)

d. Install the pressure test tool for cooling system to the filler port of the auxiliary coolant tank assembly of battery thermal management system.

Special tool: pressure test tool for cooling system

e. Apply a pressure in the range of 15kPa \~ 45kPa.

f. Check whether the coolant leaks or the pressure of the battery temperature control system drops.

### i Caution:

If the pressure of battery temperature control system drops, which indicates that there is a leakage point in the system, check and repair the system.

g. Remove the pressure test tool for cooling system and install the auxiliary coolant tank cover of battery thermal management system.

h. Install the front right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly

### 1. Preparations

a. Drive the vehicle into the lifting position, activate the parking brake, and power off the vehicle.

2. Remove the front motor lower mudguard assembly. Refer to: Front motor lower mudguard assembly

3. Remove the front right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly

### i Caution:

Remove the battery thermal management auxiliary coolant tank cover after the battery temperature control system is completely cooled.

0 Tip:

Turn the battery thermal management auxiliary coolant tank cover counterclockwise slowly (do not press it down) until it is removed. Such slow operation can gradually relieve residual pressure in the battery temperature control system.

![](images/53d5bd8c79b78f1eec53750535ec3be6577d18882e30dd4c78e94edb5f7f0c1a.webp)

c. After the coolant is drained, install the outlet pipe assembly ① of battery pack and fix it with elastic clamps.

### 5. Add coolant.

Coolant capacity of battery temperature control system: 5±0.2L
Coolant specification of battery temperature control system: -40℃ freezing point (Material
No.:13625837-00)(3.5L / Barrel)

a. Fill in the battery thermal management auxiliary coolant tank with the coolant, until reaching the “MAX” mark. b. Start the vehicle, and power it off after driving the coolant pump with VDS for about 5min.

### 0 Tip:

Fill the battery thermal management auxiliary coolant tank with coolant continuously until the coolant level is between "MIN” mark and "MAX" mark and does not change. • When driven by VDS for exhaust, the coolant pump will enter the self-protection mode and stop working if any air exists in it. In this case, some coolant needs to be discharged from its coolant outlet, so that the air can be discharged together with such coolant. c. Start the vehicle again and check the battery temperature control system for any leakage. d. Install the battery thermal management auxiliary coolant tank cover and fasten it.

6. Clear spilled coolant

7. Install the front motor lower mudguard assembly. Refer to: Front motor lower mudguard assembly
8. Install the front right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly

### 3.4.2.1 Recommended tools and equipment

![](images/099e814c604ceae3d9f3b0257bee04e0c9e7453c1a6ca0e3d7b7906a6c737f22.webp)

![](images/e09380185d787b5ded116e195633edf5d13a707bc292bc45668f4c7a875ced56.webp)

![](images/38cb06146387fb23652abd499a671c97899ca83ae22400da34687c9be5f6956b.webp)

### 3.4.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. Professionals, who have not received high voltage training, shall not remove the high voltage battery to avoid personal injury.

2. Please do not touch or operate the power batteries without wearing corresponding protective equipment.

3. Before operation, please power off the vehicle, and disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). No other operation is allowed within 5min.

4. The orange wiring harness in the engine room is a high-voltage wiring harness. Do not touch it without discharge treatment and wearing insulating clothes.

5. In all maintenance operations involving high-voltage electrical appliances and high-voltage wiring harness areas, be sure to disable high voltage power.

6. No other operation is allowed within 5min after disabling the high voltage power.

7. Insulate and seal the disassembled and disconnected plug interfaces of high-voltage electrical appliances to avoid ingression of foreign matters.

8. Wiring harness connectors should be kept dry. If coolant or oil is accidentally splashed into high-voltage wiring harness or electrical appliances, be sure to clean and dry it with compressed air. Measure the insulation resistance of high-voltage electrical appliances or wiring harness with a megohmmeter, and install them only if the standards are met.

9. Please pay attention to high-voltage warning marks labeled on the high voltage battery and vehicle in the process of removal.

10.Some parts have the locking function. Do not use excessive force to avoid damaging them in the process of removal.

11.Take care to protect the power batteries in the process of removal.

12.Avoid violent disassembly, falls, collision, or trampling of the high voltage battery pack.

13.Do not puncture, squeeze, place at high temperature or bake the high voltage battery pack.

### 3.4.3.2 System descriptions

1. The high voltage battery pack is integrated with：

a. Battery management system.
b. High voltage power distribution box.
c. Contactors.
d. Pre-charge resistance.
e. HV fuse.
f. Coolant pipes.

2. Main functions

![](images/9998b8c1eff96cd88977e285a319e6ecc060814e50523e55a45ebcab0ab58093.webp)

a. Battery management controller (BMC).

• Its main functions include charging and discharging management, contactor control, power control, abnormality alarm and protection of battery, SOC/SOH calculation, self-inspection and communication.

b. BIC.

BIC(Battery Information Collector) is integrated inside the battery pack, there are 17 BICs to collect battery voltage and temperature information.

c. HVSU.

• Pack voltage： check bus bar voltage for battery pack.
• Link voltage： check bus bar voltage of the downstream of the (HV+/HV-) contactor. • HV+ contactor sintering inspection： check the working state of HV+ contactor in real time, then send to BMC.
• HV- contactor sintering inspection： check the working state of HV-contactor in real time, then send to BMC.
• Pack current detection： check the current go through the pack power cable in real time, then send to BMC.
• Insulation inspection： check insulation resistance of the HV system.

d. High voltage battery sampling wire.

The main function is to connect BMC, HVSU and BIC to realize the communication and information exchange among them.

### 3.4.6.2 Fault Mode of Battery Pack

display of instrument cluster fault: EV function limit, overtemperature warning and high voltage battery fault

### 1. Fault Mode of Battery Pack

a. Power battery over heat.
b. BIC(Battery Information Collector) fault.
c. BMC(Battery Management Controller) fault.
d. SOC(State Of Charge) jump and short mileage.
e. Battery pack abnormally disengaged.

### Power battery over heat

1. The over-temperature of battery pack is classified into two cases: signal acquisition distortion due to sensor fault; excessive heat during charging and discharging due to too large resistance of the battery pack.
2. When the battery pack is overheated, the instrument cluster will report the overheat alarm of high voltage battery system and high voltage battery fault.

a. The overheat warning indicator of high voltage battery is as shown in the figure:

![](images/8d4997e6946c6fcdd6decec75859c5b742abc0a7fa6413b16f7b0dd740a3a715.webp)

### BIC fault

1. BIC(Battery Information Collector) is integrated inside the battery pack, there are 17 BICs to collect battery voltage and temperature information.
2. When BIC fails, the voltage and temperature information of the battery module cannot be collected.

### BMC fault

1. BMC communicates with BIC and HVSU (High Voltage Supervising Unit) through SPI (Serial Peripheral Interface) to monitor the working condition of high voltage battery pack.
2. During DC charging, BMC communicates with CCS through DC charging CAN, collects the temperature signal of DC charging port, and controls the anode and cathode DC charging contactors inside the charging and distribution assembly.
3. It communicates with other modules through power CAN.
4. When the vehicle collides, it receives the collision signal and forcibly cuts off the power.
5. When BMC fails, the high voltage battery pack cannot be charged or discharged.

### SOC jump and short mileage

1. SOC jump of battery pack: Since the voltage of one or more cells in the battery pack is too low, the vehicle SOC will modify it according to the voltage. In this case, SOC jump occurs and the vehicle will correct the driving range to the one under the current SOC value automatically as response.

### Power battery over heat

1. Turn on the fault indicator a. The instrument cluster will turn on the overheat warning indicator of high voltage battery and the fault indicator of high voltage battery, as shown in the figure:

![](images/7fad494a5ea17b6876bb5718f265bad8ea34a991fc0d4a325a05bbe07c0720a9.webp)

### 2. Steps:

a. Use VDS to read and clear the DTC of high voltage battery. Refer to: DTC reading and clearing b. Check whether the following DTCs exist. If yes, the temperature sampling is abnormal; If not, go to the next step.

![](images/926dc72d83fef1b2bbcda4333d1609704a2883313e96e89dae87c2902d37f828.webp)

![](images/a8290cc8103b267fad428789e4c1b279aabd857faef0a3d792d4526f7e4106c8.webp)

c. Use VDS to read the data flow of high voltage battery, check the actual temperature of the battery, and then check the working status of battery thermal management system. If abnormal, go to the next step. Refer to: Read data flow

![](images/eda8e06aa8257a69f0b0fe75427c2e1e2f0676d985938b7633810d3b8668aca4.webp)

d. Check the high voltage battery temperature control system:

Check whether the coolant in the battery temperature control system is insufficient. Refer to: Check battery temperature control system
Check whether the auxiliary coolant tank of battery thermal management system, battery cooling plate heat exchanger assembly, three-way valve, coolant pipeline and battery heater are faulty.
Check whether the coolant pump fuse of battery thermal management system and its circuit are faulty.
Use VDS to check whether there is any DTC in the HVAC system. If so, refer to the DTC list for maintenance. Refer to: DTC list (DTC)

### BIC fault

1. Use VDS to read and clear the DTC of high voltage battery. Refer to: DTC reading and clearing
2. Check whether the following DTCs exist. If so, replace the high voltage battery pack.

![](images/8908e701725386902cfe76ac017572e383d31ec8c1da6129c9fb8ee2139acbf8.webp)

![](images/bd4bed345a9194b1483b6b58415fa6879e76a6dcafded9ee0a3358a8ed9c77bc.webp)

### BMS fault

1. Use VDS to read and clear the DTC of high voltage battery. Refer to: DTC reading and clearing
2. Check whether the following DTCs exist.

![](images/6e59ab985759e8a65a787bbe249a612536e686b1a488630329925ca659cdaab2.webp)

### SOC jump and short mileage

1. Use VDS to read and clear the DTC of high voltage battery. Refer to: DTC reading and clearing
2. Check whether the following DTCs exist.

![](images/3fae96e125301dc6e7368d535c4f0777385d7bf3f3ece5d0c347e7e748e86c56.webp)

![](images/cb58266f302ea966caa1a967048d8f4c217cc28a181a19a6fd0e436cf8b68e79.webp)

### Electric leakage of high voltage battery pack

1. Electric leakage monitoring is aimed at the whole high voltage circuit system, which is divided into general electric leakage and serious electric leakage according to the standard.

2. Check whether there is leakage fault in each high-voltage electrical appliance and highvoltage wiring harness step by step to exclude the possibility of leakage. After confirmation, determine whether to replace the battery pack to eliminate the leakage fault.

### Battery pack abnormally disengaged

1. Impact against the protection structure of battery pack or itself: There is a shield as protective measure under the high voltage battery pack carrier. Due to external human or environmental factors, the battery pack may be impacted by the battery pack protection plate during driving, which may damage or fall off, andthe battery pack core may be damaged in severe cases.

2. Handling method. Refer to: Visual inspection standard of high voltage battery pack

### 3.4.7.2 DTC reading and clearing

Use VDS to read and clear the vehicle fault codes, and determine the current DTC to help maintenance personnel to test quickly.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module” → “Battery management system 505(BYD)”

6. Read and clear the DTC.

a. Select “Fault detection” to read DTC.
b. Select “Clear fault” to clear DTC.

![](images/d42808f77c665244c51acdc60b12d94484f7bb4f9aa9437e4f05f3bac45c6c6a.webp)

### Read data flow

According to the display on VDS, read the data flow of the current system, and read the working state information of high voltage battery without disassembling any parts. Reading the data flow first when troubleshooting can improve work efficiency.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module” → “Battery management system 505(BYD)”

6. Read data flow

![](images/fe1370d30e1684d78a2ba68827b830160f0e92323c21480afc100850e71ac5e3.webp)

a. Select “Data flow” to read the data flow.
b. Select "DC charging data flow" to read the DC charging data flow.
c. Select Module information" to read the module information.
d. Select Equilibrium information" to read the equilibrium information.
e. Select "Sampling information" to read the sampling information.

### Data flow

### 3.4.7.4 Action test

Without disassembling any parts, use VDS to conduct action test on the suspected parts, and then judge whether the suspected parts function normally. Active test when troubleshooting can avoid unnecessary disassembly and improve diagnosis efficiency and accuracy.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” “ECU module” → “Battery management system 505(BYD)”

6. Action test

![](images/f97402161b65c9a799bc10cdd1ee6be4255e699a83040da897b6c7989d3cd4da.webp)

a. Select "Action test" to perform active test on the high voltage battery pack.
b. Select "one button battery cooling active test" to perform cooling test on the high voltage battery pack.
c. Select "one button heating active test" to perform heating test on the high voltage battery pack.
d. Select "leakage detection control switch off" to perform leakage detection control switch off test on the high voltage battery pack.
e. Select "Hard wire interlock shield" to perform hard wire interlock shield test on the high voltage battery pack.

a. Read and clear the DTC. Refer to: DTC reading and clearing
b. Check if the fault code exists.

Diagnose it as an occasional fault.

Yes

![](images/7f7e2b0c597ee2f9af6eb6eed09dce71f04d765cebb7b53e32b611767b1f9485.webp)

a. The high-voltage power is disabled. Refer to: High Voltage Power Disable and Enable b. Check the high-voltage electrical appliances and high-voltage wiring harness for insulation fault in turn with an insulation meter. c. Check whether the result is normal?

No

Replace the faulty high-voltage electrical appliances or high-voltage wiring harness.

Yes

![](images/0379a8cb055f8cc79acb962c950be88e72cd25155ad118ab180991352b0cd464.webp)

a. Check and replace the high voltage battery pack.

Troubleshooting.

Follow the above diagnostic steps and check again.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the engine trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Engine trimming panel assembly
2. Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). Refer to: Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery)
3. Disable the high voltage power. Refer to: High voltage power disable and enable
4. Remove the front motor lower mudguard assembly. Refer to: Front motor lower mudguard assembly
5. Remove the battery pack rear mudguard assembly. Refer to: Battery pack rear mudguard assembly
6. Remove the pipeline shield assembly at the vehicle bottom on both sides. Refer to: Pipeline shield assembly at the vehicle bottom

7. Remove the high-voltage battery pack.

![](images/955730c71bc3aebaa52e550c901a9af9ef6ef8dde239e832ac7ac583cc6f2626.webp)

a. Remove the elastic clamp A and disconnect the inlet pipe of high voltage battery pack; remove the elastic clamp B and disconnect the outlet pipe of high voltage battery pack to drain the coolant.

Special tools: protective cover of battery pack, plug, coolant pipe plug

### 0 Tip:

Recycle coolant using a recycling container, and dispose of waste coolant in accordance with local laws and regulations. Blow out residual coolant by compressed air. Seal the high voltage battery pack and the coolant pipe connection port.

b. Disconnect the high voltage battery pack connector C, and install a special plug on the high voltage battery port. Special tools: protective cover of battery pack, plug, low voltage plug
c. Remove the 2 fixing bolts D, pull out the HV power cable of high voltage battery pack, and install a special plug on the high voltage battery port.
Special tools: protective cover of battery pack,
plug, high voltage plug
Torque: 7±1N•m

！ Warning:

After the HV power cable is disconnected, use a special plug to seal the high voltage battery port and the wiring harness end to prevent electric leakage or dust.

![](images/4cc92b92dfd9a6bcdd9fff7eae1c39dc4ba1df8c68ec73347bb4b8ddd30ceccc.webp)

d. Remove the 2 fixing bolts, and pull out the HV wiring harness of the rear drive electric powertrain.

Special tools: protective cover of battery pack,
plug, high voltage plug
Torque: 7±1N•m

！ Warning: After the HV power cable is disconnected, use a special plug to seal the high voltage battery port and the wiring harness end to prevent electric leakage or dust.

![](images/75e88039c4c39682f3cdd8548d0a9b6e25c52537f02dda39259f8652ac59240e.webp)

e. Use a battery pack lifting platform to support the high voltage battery, remove 10 fixing bolts from the high voltage battery pack, lower and move out such battery pack.

Torque: 135±5N•m

！ Warning: Since the high voltage battery pack is very heavy, operate the battery pack lifting platform in accordance with the operating specifications to avoid tilting or unbalanced placement. Avoid violent disassembly, falls, collision, or trampling of the high voltage battery pack.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the high voltage battery pack in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

![](images/ab5ee96414c6d7e611fd700f3d9e436029d85e69a5d5e562c3bd72d9a08364c7.webp)

a. Lift the high voltage battery pack slowly, and align the battery pack positioning hole seat ② with body locating pins ① (two places) until the mounting base of high voltage battery pack is attached to the body before pre-tightening the fixing bolts.

### 0 Tip:

There are 2 locating pins on the body. There are totally 10 mounting hole bases on the high voltage battery pack, of which the corresponding positions to the locating pins are the locating hole bases (taper holes), and the non-corresponding positions are the ordinary mounting hole bases (straight holes).

b. Pay attention to observe whether there are parts interfering each other above the high voltage battery pack in the lifting process to prevent squeezing.
c. Lock the connector firmly.
d. Add coolant. Refer to: Replace coolant (battery temperature control system)
e. After installation, carry out charging inspection and road test inspection to ensure normal input and output of high voltage battery pack.

### 3.5.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. Professionals, who have not received high voltage training, shall not remove the front drive electric powertrain to avoid personal injury.

2. Please do not touch or operate the front drive electric powertrain without wearing corresponding protective equipment.

3. Do not touch the front drive motor directly when it is running or just stopped; otherwise there will be a risk of scald.

4. Before operation, please power off the vehicle, and disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). No other operation is allowed within 5min.

5. The orange wiring harness in the engine room is a high-voltage wiring harness. Do not touch it without discharge treatment and wearing insulating clothes.

6. In all maintenance operations involving high-voltage electrical appliances and high-voltage wiring harness areas, be sure to disable high voltage power.

7. No other operation is allowed within 5min after disabling the high voltage power.

8. Insulate and seal the disassembled and disconnected plug interfaces of high-voltage electrical appliances to avoid ingression of foreign matters.

9. Wiring harness connectors should be kept dry. If coolant or oil is accidentally splashed into high-voltage wiring harness or electrical appliances, be sure to clean and dry it with compressed air. Measure the insulation resistance of high-voltage electrical appliances or wiring harness with a megohmmeter, and install them only if the standards are met.

10.Please pay attention to high-voltage warning marks labeled on the front drive electric powertrain and vehicle in the process of removal.

11.Some parts have the locking function. Do not use excessive force to avoid damaging them in the process of removal.

12.Take care to protect the front drive electric powertrain in the process of removal.

13.Avoid violent disassembly, falls, collision, or trampling of the front drive electric powertrain.

14.When discharging and filling gear oil, be sure to take protective measures to prevent it from polluting parts.

### 1. System Overview

a. The front drive electric powertrain is mainly composed of front drive motor controller, front drive motor, differential, etc. The front drive motor contains resolver and temperature sensor.

### 2. Main functions

a. Front drive motor controller.

Convert high voltage DC into three-phase AC, receive the vehicle control instruction, and change the frequency and direction of AC, so as to control the forward, speed and backward of the vehicle.
During the braking energy recovery, convert three-phase AC into high voltage DC to charge the high voltage battery pack.
• There is a charging module in the front drive motor controller, which provide high voltage DC power to high voltage battery by converting DC input voltage based on FRONT drive motor coil.

b. Front drive motor.

Under the control of the front drive motor controller, drive the vehicle. During the braking energy recovery, convert kinetic energy into electric energy to transmit to the front drive motor controller. During DC charging, the DC voltage is boosted through the coil of the front drive motor to provide high-voltage DC power for the high voltage battery. c. Resolver. Resolver is a type of rotary electrical transformer used for measuring degrees position of rotation. Detecting the position and speed of motor rotor in real time to realize the closed-loop control of torque and speed. Resolver shield ground cable should be well connected with vehicle ground in case of resolver signal error. Resolver shield ground is one of the drive motor ground cable.

d. Motor temperature sensor.

Measure the temperature of front drive motor.

### 3.5.7.2 DTC reading and clearing

Use VDS to read and clear the vehicle fault codes, and determine the current DTC to help maintenance personnel to test quickly.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module” → “Front drive motor controller(BYD)”

6. Read and clear the DTC.

![](images/d48e0bc88abe63b094277575bcad9767ae36de13c27b11c6a17c8d51d836f08b.webp)

a. Select “Fault detection” to read DTC.
b. Select “Clear fault” to clear DTC.

### Read data flow

According to the display on VDS, read the data flow of the current system, and read the working state information of the front drive motor assembly without disassembling any parts. Reading the data flow first when troubleshooting can improve work efficiency.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module” → “Front drive motor controller(BYD)”

6. Read data flow

a. Select “Data flow” to read the data flow.

Follow the above diagnostic steps and check again.

### Replacing front drive transmission gear oil

1. Lift the vehicle.

2. Remove the front motor lower mudguard assembly. Refer to: Front motor lower mudguard assembly

3. Drain the front drive transmission gear oil

![](images/63e5b39bedec2e4cbc25dada2bdb827c46c2b4f8600bac3ac45ce01e4143b904.webp)

a. Remove the oil drain plug of front drive transmission.

### 0 Tip:

Collect waste gear oil with the gear oil collection device, and dispose of it according to local laws and regulations.

b. Install and tighten the oil drain plug after discharge Torque: 50±3N•m c. Clean the gear oil around the oil drain hole.

4. Fill the front drive transmission gear oil a. Remove the oil filler plug of front drive transmission.

![](images/b357a3f480902846f0b8024a3b22314194a95d4f1e44ced26dac7c00365613f2.webp)

b. Fill the front drive transmission gear oil with the gear oil filling machine.

Specification of gear oil①: Castrol ON D2 Specification of gear oil②: Castrol BOT384 Specification of gear oil③: Shell S3-ATF-MD3 Filling amount of gear oil: 0.85±0.1L

c. Install and tighten the oil filler plug after filling. Torque: 37±2 N•m d. Clean the gear oil around the fuel filler cap. e. Lower the vehicle and move it out of the station.

### Calibration procedures

1. Record the motor zero-position code.

![](images/1d2330259a9f0cb5501f86e2bd1b33f6582d04c54a5502e7de679faad2e31b32.webp)

a. Record the motor zero-position code on the front drive motor. After the assembly is completed, use VDS (VDS is updated to the latest version) to perform the motor electronic control zeroposition calibration. The motor zero-position code is as shown in the red box.

2. The vehicle is powered off.
3. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
4. Start the vehicle.
5. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
6. Zero-position calibration

![](images/7f3203810d62e77706adafe22b8876781207ae701dda146580ff26d94691edf5.webp)

a. Select "VDS2000 Vehicle Diagnosis System".

![](images/8d7965c164c2b9678e57beb02b25408113ca015c1eaa2242bcc2477fe4f0ec47.webp)

b. Select Passenger car".

![](images/7c86c5eca9b6a6fa7e083745b5d4fd1f5aba7cc13d2aa28f58994f2637ffb1d2.webp)

c. Select "EV series".

![](images/f862d3f697c1a3f20301fb0fee058116c36278d8a20683f0457b823e708cb08f.webp)

d. Select "New Tang EV 2021".

![](images/95667749a91fbb01031612d6285de5348801d3a92a2b8a2704af27a061c9e30a.webp)

e. Select "New Tang EV 2021 General".

![](images/a135869d411efdf5e2608713c7ae0226033e35c4f43cc31a455a2c9aa063ecd4.webp)

f. Select ECU module".

![](images/150cde8a39abcb1eb6ecb6fa80655c67e9908e09217fc7b1bc46c13d75bbeb20.webp)

T-4205A40

g. Select the arrow shown in the figure.

![](images/6992fe880b76366867e3c5c3c77f1b3391aae42b91fd19e0e7488f37ed13941d.webp)

h. Select "Data flow".

![](images/aa04a18f437b0aeb2510899ad6b6aa5d27eb6386db75f37ddcbf3d36828ecd60.webp)

i. Click the run button to read the data flow.

![](images/9f2a7d338888e6fbf5df4ccb41be194dc7ec9cf437408c65aa40ebd6b94de8fc.webp)

j. Check and record the original zero-position code of front drive motor.

![](images/db9427bfa131a31c21151816682c684c6e1f7503df913cb0a1c642e60ed103bf.webp)

T-4205A44

k. Click the stop button to stop reading data flow and return to the front motor controller page.

![](images/0cfd45452b84b9d12a7a190635d1285effa71860f991b123b202e9e6769c1bbe.webp)

l. Select "motor back to 0 point calibration".

![](images/0d792b6c9e544cbbda71df0b5bf5f6cde40f9e307f68fc69d6c45061ae18adb0.webp)

m. Click Read".

![](images/58f01595b9b5a8a6cf41c514ec52ff7bbe191fe4e7767ece23924c5df743c3d0.webp)

n. Enter the 28-digit motor zero-position code of the loading motor (pay attention to capital and small letter) and click the run button.

![](images/6edfb185e1486b01c15822660c2624257b1aba2777758de90af1bdb3348aed2f.webp)

o. If the code is correct, there is a prompt of "Operation succeeded" indicating that the zeroposition calibration is successful.

7. Restart the vehicle. VDS page operation: read the data flow to confirm whether the zeroposition calibration is successful and whether the zero-position code is correct (i.e., whether the latest zero-position code is consistent with the zero-position code of the current motor barcode).

### 0 Tip:

After zero-position calibration, the calibrated zero-position code can only be read after restarting the vehicle.
If the input of the zero barcode of the motor is correct, a “negative response” will be prompted during calibration, and several attempts can be made. If the “negative response” is still prompted, please record the barcode of the motor, the motor controller and the VIN of the vehicle, and timely feed it back to the manufacturer for handling.
The last four digits of the motor barcode are zero-position code, and the zero-position code displayed in the VDS data flow is checked against the zero-position code on the motor barcode.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the engine trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Engine trimming panel assembly
2. Remove the front left/right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly
3. Remove the grille upper cover assembly. Refer to: Grille upper cover assembly
4. Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). Refer to: Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery)
5. Disable the high voltage power. Refer to: High voltage power disable and enable
6. Remove the front motor lower mudguard assembly. Refer to: Front motor lower mudguard assembly
7. Drain coolant from the motor cooling system. Refer to: Replace coolant (cooling system)
8. Drain the front drive transmission gear oil. Refer to: Replace front drive transmission gear oil
9. Remove the front left/right wheel assembly. Refer to: Wheel assembly
10.Remove the front left/right drive half shaft assembly. Refer to: Front drive half shaft assembly
11.Remove the charging and distribution assembly. Refer to: Charging and distribution assembly
12.Remove the electric coolant pump assembly and bracket. Refer to: Electric coolant pump assembly Ⅰ
13.Remove the electric compressor assembly. Refer to: Electric compressor assembly

### 0 Tip:

When disassembling the electric compressor assembly, it is not necessary to disconnect the A/C pipe. After removing the fixing bolts, fix the electric compressor assembly aside with ropes.

### 14.Remove the front drive electric powertrain

![](images/36a727afd95b1d4f360bf7b7c71d0bcd89ab218edcf4b730b38070ae4f21fa94.webp)

a. Disconnect the connector A of front drive electric powertrain and disengage each wiring harness fixing clip.
b. Remove the elastic clamp B and disconnect the coolant outlet pipe of front drive electric powertrain.

![](images/a5a1064c754cbcc18354b7cf45b8994a39864fdb96b766d6aa1ba6a95edf952a.webp)

c. Remove one fixing bolt and move away the front ground wire of front drive electric powertrain. Torque: 18±1N•m

![](images/526f71dc302b5d8c551a0cf18a620e07d4f23df718589af9520ba94ba05264e7.webp)

d. Remove one fixing bolt and disconnect the right ground wire of front drive electric powertrain. Torque: 18±1N•m

![](images/8d8771aa14c12fdf97b2313ad9c5559b7d9fd3d72142c3bb346a833e8b46e0a3.webp)

e. Disconnect the coolant temperature sensor connector and disengage the wiring harness fixing clip.

![](images/23a2b087fdd07f4992a466dd67dee37d38c750408ef807cad75ac86c427a15e6.webp)

f. Remove one fixing bolt and disconnect the coolant pipeline bracket. Torque: 12±2.4N•m

g. Check the periphery of front drive electric powertrain, and disconnect all connected wiring harnesses and pipeline fixing clips to ensure that there is redundant connection. h. Use the front drive electric powertrain bracket to support the front drive electric powertrain together with the hydraulic lifting platform, and apply slight force on the front drive electric powertrain.

![](images/3a4b91c0dfe408afcd6c04cdbb681a4e41578079f1eee62715188592b2803c56.webp)

i. Remove one fixing bolt A and 3 fixing bolts B, and take off the front suspension support assembly of powertrain.

Torque of bolt A: 85±5N•m Torque of bolt B: 85±5N•m j. Remove one fixing bolt of the right suspension support assembly of powertrain. Torque: 85±5N•m

![](images/358ef7ea4087650710b4a32409f6b271190717d8a5322abaa2e7b991ee843e9a.webp)

![](images/6a570dce5c56afacc0e730f304e600c5f9c6c2bfb8310c13b5844316fdd116c5.webp)

k. Remove one fixing bolt A and 3 fixing bolts B, and take off the rear suspension support assembly of powertrain by moving the front drive electric powertrain.

Torque of bolt A: 85±5N•m Torque of bolt B: 85±5N•m

l. Slowly lower the hydraulic lifting platform and remove the front drive electric powertrain.

A Caution: During lowering, check whether there are interfering parts around the front drive electric powertrain, which should be removed or avoided.

### Disassembly procedure

1. Disassemble the front drive electric powertrain a. Remove the 3 fixing bolts of the right suspension support assembly of powertrain, and take off the right suspension support assembly of powertrain.

![](images/5d3a641f85a98408874141fa4371d78dbde39159824c72b549ca790b55be08f6.webp)

b. Remove the breather plug assembly. Torque: 16±2 N•m

![](images/620734abd5fcfce377f05bfa471caa89220a2e97ff505bd85c7c86a6029842fe.webp)

c. Remove 1 stud A and 12 fixing bolts B, and pry up the motor end cover.

Caution: Remove the fixing bolts in diagonal order.

Torque of stud A: 6±1N•m Torque of fixing bolt B: 6±1N•m d. Remove the 2 fixing bolts and take off the shielding case. Torque: 6±1N•m

![](images/0da44684b1fa763236edb9083b7705e1e9e4019e3d1b33f3e2c6c882e52c96c2.webp)

![](images/1fda8b9d0ea5b9d25ca788fcd18563c4b1473c5f1ef99a8a127f937d153c0cb1.webp)

e. Remove the 3 fixing bolts of three-phase wire and disconnect one connector A. Torque: 10.5±1N•m

![](images/fc70e437fdeba9a1e14109b6222363181d1c4557ce429ead75c2a191ddf044d1.webp)

f. Remove the 5 fixing bolts and take off the motor controller assembly vertically upwards.

i Caution: Remove the fixing bolts in diagonal order.

Torque: 35±1N•m

![](images/52a5c4b3e5a1b8ecd566aa6686af2caaf0a9024bddbb3892c2b55a4587d4fd1a.webp)

g. Replace the O-ring with a new one and protect the coolant inlet from bumping.

0 Tip: Use a pneumatic gun to dry the residual water at coolant inlet and outlet.

![](images/a99bc643dbba768effa953960cb259c1014667c2fa5c515a702397cf18a3f7da.webp)

h. Replace the controller seal ring with a new one.

![](images/4dd64a3887303345f255f2fc31d7957d90e86f0ec056a4d06014709afbc87b6c.webp)

i. If it is necessary to check the internal gears of the transmission, remove the 16 fixing bolts A and 3 fixing bolts B and separate the left and right cases of the transmission.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Remove the fixing bolts in diagonal order. Since the right case of transmission is integrated with the drive motor, only the left case of transmission can be removed.
>
> ![](images/02d3407e1496dfd73376018679f981026aab774207bf7dba5c6306b4324cc3de.webp)
>
> j. Remove the clamp spring A of input shaft, and take off the input shaft ①, countershaft ② and differential ③ together.

### i Caution:

According to the maintenance requirements, dismantle the corresponding parts for maintenance or replacement.

### Assembly procedure

1. Assemble the front drive electric powertrain in an order reverse to its disassembly and pay attention to the following:

![](images/8f1e9a95e61d7a98a5965065ceb5e909afd8b2291d2b49f3f28a328eadc30d69.webp)

a. Install the input shaft ①, countershaft ② and differential ③ together, and then install the clamp spring A of input shaft.

### i Caution:

After installation, turn the clamp spring and check that it is correctly installed in the clamp spring groove.
Turn the input shaft and check that all gears rotate smoothly.
b. Remove the residual sealant on the joint surfaces of the left and right cases of transmission.
c. Apply sealant to the joint surface of the left case of transmission, with the adhesive track along the inner side of the bolt hole. Specification of sealant: TONSAN 1596F

![](images/23cdf4c59ea22e3032122d1c0c7dc7be9295728e73c7111a1ac3d8b93ff2c138.webp)

d. Rotate the fixing disc on the countershaft so that its 3 bolt holes are aligned with the 3 bolt holes on the left case of transmission as much as possible.

e. Close the left case of transmission, and insert 2 screwdrivers or equivalent tools into the bolt holes of the fixing disc on the countershaft through the bolt holes of the left case of transmission before touching the sealant, so that the bolt holes are aligned to facilitate the installation of bolts.

### 0 Tip:

Avoid the fixing disc falling into the gear groove.

f. Install a long bolt into another bolt hole and screw it in several turns.

g. Remove the screwdriver and install the 2 fixing bolts.
h. Remove the long bolt and install the remaining one fixing bolt.
i. Install other fixing bolts of transmission case in diagonal order.

![](images/6a0aa87a4ae3f4bcaa40257575bebf780e60c768b3d9157d00967fdf419d36df.webp)

j. Fasten the 16 fixing bolts A and 3 fixing bolts B in diagonal order. Torque: 25±2 N•m

k. Remove the residual sealant on the motor end cover and mounting surface.

![](images/eb723331207fc804140a5273d2f866af37574d98036d4832d6f21a08dd5772dc.webp)

l. As shown in the figure, apply glue to the motor end cover, with the adhesive track along the inner side of the bolt hole. Specification of sealant: TONSAN 1596F

![](images/643d9793d0f585eafbcc6a687dc476e265f941f38d70e60ff39011347973d920.webp)

m. Pay attention to checking the O-ring of coolant inlet pipe during installation to ensure that the Oring is installed in place.

n. Install the fixing bolts in diagonal order.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the front drive electric powertrain in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

![](images/39563f81ec9bb8e9888b151721a9cea3afadfc5a11625f8b757c2b09e761d92d.webp)

a. Record the motor zero-position barcode on the motor. After the assembly is completed, use VDS to perform the motor electronic control zeroposition calibration. Refer to: Zero-position calibration

b. Replace the damaged fixing clips and cable ties, and fix them firmly. c. Add coolant. Refer to: Replace coolant (cooling system) d. Fill the front drive transmission gear oil. Refer to: Replacing front drive transmission gear oil e. After installation, start the vehicle and conduct a road test inspection.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the engine trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Engine trimming panel assembly
2. Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). Refer to: Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery)
3. Remove the rear trimming panel assembly of auxiliary dashboard. Refer to: Rear trimming panel assembly of auxiliary dashboard
4. Remove the gearshift control mechanism cover assembly. Refer to: Gearshift control mechanism cover assembly
5. Remove the gearshift control mechanism panel

assembly a. Remove the 4 fixing bolts of gearshift control mechanism assembly. Torque: 10 N•m

![](images/8b11f54213104e26e6152e93f9753315374962805d70786c2e5fb33c30f51535.webp)

b. Disconnect the connector and remove the gearshift control mechanism assembly.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the gearshift control mechanism assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

a. The connector should be installed firmly.
b. After installation, check that the shifting gears of vehicle should be normal.

### Removal procedures

0 Tip: This manual takes the removal and installation of the left differential oil seal as an example. For the removal and installation of the right differential oil seal, please refer to the left side.
1. Remove the front motor lower mudguard assembly. Refer to: Front motor lower mudguard assembly
2. Remove the front wheel assembly. Refer to: Wheel assembly
3. Remove the front drive half shaft assembly. Refer to: Front drive half shaft assembly
4. Remove the differential oil seal

![](images/cedcc1731756b97e7f28c976de3d469feeba15990b0890f878fec5a96deb7499.webp)

a. Remove the differential oil seal with the removal tools for oil seal.

### i Caution:

The differential oil seal must be replaced after removal.
When removing the differential oil seal, avoid damaging the differential oil seal mounting base.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the differential oil seal in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

a. Install the differential oil seal on the installation tool for motor half shaft oil seal. Special tool: installation tool for motor half shaft oil seal
b. Align the installation tool for motor half shaft oil seal with the differential oil seal mounting base hole.
c. Gently tap the installation tool for motor half shaft oil seal with a hammer to install the differential oil seal, so as to ensure that the differential oil seal and oil seal lip are smooth without bumps.
d. After all components are installed, perform road test inspection to ensure that the differential oil seal does not leak oil.

### 3.6.2.1 Recommended tools and equipment

![](images/e9f22abb98f8008ee16f15ae29f73e1bba91f430a6fa54972b134be8311c4859.webp)

![](images/fffabed0a5df9f7c46904145c48d3bda908ed80b1af023bfab468446482ba894.webp)

![](images/bb9595bb60fc36def7b6cf996db5e566ef3a876f66aad25f098f423af4cd7842.webp)

### 3.6.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. Professionals, who have not received high voltage training, shall not remove the rear drive electric powertrain to avoid personal injury.

2. Please do not touch or operate the rear drive electric powertrain without wearing corresponding protective equipment.

3. Do not touch the rear drive motor directly when it is running or just stopped; otherwise there will be a risk of scald.

4. Before operation, please power off the vehicle, and disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). No other operation is allowed within 5min.

5. The orange wiring harness in the engine room is a high-voltage wiring harness. Do not touch it without discharge treatment and wearing insulating clothes.

6. In all maintenance operations involving high-voltage electrical appliances and high-voltage wiring harness areas, be sure to disable high voltage power.

7. No other operation is allowed within 5min after disabling the high voltage power.

8. Insulate and seal the disassembled and disconnected plug interfaces of high-voltage electrical appliances to avoid ingression of foreign matters.

9. Wiring harness connectors should be kept dry. If coolant or oil is accidentally splashed into high-voltage wiring harness or electrical appliances, be sure to clean and dry it with compressed air. Measure the insulation resistance of high-voltage electrical appliances or wiring harness with a megohmmeter, and install them only if the standards are met.

10.Please pay attention to high-voltage warning marks labeled on the rear drive electric powertrain and vehicle in the process of removal.

11.Some parts have the locking function. Do not use excessive force to avoid damaging them in the process of removal.

12.Take care to protect the rear drive electric powertrain in the process of removal.

13.Avoid violent disassembly, falls, collision, or trampling of the rear drive electric powertrain.

14.When discharging and filling gear oil, be sure to take protective measures to prevent it from polluting parts.

### 1. System Overview

a. The rear drive electric powertrain is mainly composed of rear drive motor controller, rear drive motor, differential, etc. The rear drive motor contains resolver and temperature sensor.

### 2. Main functions

a. Rear drive motor controller. Convert high voltage DC into three-phase AC, receive the vehicle control instruction, and change the frequency and direction of AC, so as to control the reverse, speed and backward of the vehicle.
b. Rear drive motor. • Under the control of the rear drive motor controller, drive the vehicle.
c. Resolver. Resolver is a type of rotary electrical transformer used for measuring degrees position of rotation. Detecting the position and speed of motor rotor in real time to realize the closed-loop control of torque and speed. Resolver shield ground cable should be well connected with vehicle ground in case of resolver signal error. Resolver shield ground is one of the drive motor ground cable.

d. Motor temperature sensor.

Measure the temperature of rear drive motor.
