### Removal procedures

1. Remove the engine trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Engine trimming panel assembly
2. Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). Refer to: Disconnect the
cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery)
3. Remove the middle toolkit assembly of boot. Refer to: Middle toolkit assembly of boot
4. Remove the boot sill pedal assembly. Refer to: Boot sill pedal assembly
5. Remove the rear left door sill shield assembly. Refer to: Rear door sill shield assembly
6. Remove the left C-pillar lower shield assembly. Refer to: C-pillar lower shield assembly
7. Remove the left C-pillar upper shield assembly. Refer to: C-pillar upper shield assembly
8. Remove the boot left facing assembly. Refer to: Boot left facing assembly
9. Remove the rear compartment distribution box.

![](images/2778abf28e83c40a3d8c645b5693ec272a6a10ca5b2b5ceba370fd1bd5d86818.webp)

a. Remove the rear wiper relay ①.
b. Remove the charging port indicator module ②.
c. Disconnect the 4 connectors A/B/C/D and remove one fixing bolt E of the anode wiring harness. Torque: 9 N•m
d. Remove the 3 fixing nuts F and the rear compartment distribution box. Torque: 9 N•m

### Installation procedures

1. Install the rear compartment distribution box in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

a. The connector should be installed in place.
b. Power up the vehicle for checking.

### 5.18.5.2 12V battery (starter Fe battery)

Removal procedures

A Warning: Before removing the 12V battery (starter Fe battery), make sure that the intelligent charging function is OFF. If this function is ON, start the vehicle first, power off the vehicle, and then immediately remove the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery).

1. Remove the front left compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly

2. Remove 12V battery (starter Fe battery) a. Power off the vehicle.

![](images/5d485a89e81dbadd6bcebe2074af92c401d31a1fdf43cb0ea9681e7b973a18d8.webp)

b. Loosen the fixing nut A and disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). Torque: 6 N•m.

！ Warning: When removing the 12V battery (starter Fe battery), be sure to disconnect the cathode before the anode. Do not removal/installation tools (or other metal objects) to touch the positive and negative terminals of the battery at the same time; otherwise, the battery will be shortcircuited, or even explode in severe cases. After removing the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery), wrap the cathode wiring harness connector of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) with insulating tape.

c. Remove the fixing bolt B and disconnect the anode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery).

Torque: 13N•m

Warning: After removing the anode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery), wrap the anode wiring harness connector of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) with insulating tape.

![](images/28163be0e83da557ed87adc16cfd80cc83398bcea0e65da97e0f921db8336491.webp)

d. Disconnect the connector A of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery).
e. Remove the 2 fixing bolts B, remove the start battery pressure plate ① and take out the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) ② Torque: 10 N•m

i Caution:

Never bump, drop, impact or invert the 12V battery (starter Fe battery).

![](images/ab6e2caffcc944ac17fb634ce033feb1af21b9a7968f7a9176df698ab1c20b98.webp)

f. Remove the rubber gasket of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) as needed.
g. Remove the 3 fixing bolts, disengage the wiring harness fixing clips, and remove the start battery bracket.

Torque: 15 N•m

### Installation procedures

1. Install the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

a. When installing the 12V battery (starter Fe battery), be sure to connect the anode before the cathode. b. Do not reversely connect the anode and cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) c. Keep the anode and cathode posts clean, and tighten bolts or nuts after their installation.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the engine trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Engine trimming panel assembly
2. Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). a. Power off the vehicle.

![](images/ae61e7ebd3a29d6fa0862a227df61ae0a8ecfc0660cc2d080e5129c4ef8ed512.webp)

b. Loosen one fixing nut and disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery).

### ！ Warning:

Do not removal/installation tools (or other metal objects) to touch the positive and negative terminals of the battery at the same time; otherwise, the battery will be shortcircuited, or even explode in severe cases. After disconnecting the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery), wrap it with insulation tape to ensure that the cathode wiring harness does not rebound and contact with the pole post to avoid accidents.

### Installation procedures

1. Connect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

a. Keep the cathode pole post of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) clean, and tighten the nut after installation.

### 5.19.1.1 Warnings and precautions

1. As NFC key card is an electronic product, the following instructions should be observed to prevent causing function failure of or damage to it:

a. Do not place the NFC key card in the wireless charging area when the wireless charging function is activated.
b. Do not attach the NFC key card to any object that may cut its electromagnetic signals, such as smartphone metal casings.
c. Do not place the NFC key card where it is exposed to high temperatures.
d. Do not bend NFC key card with force.

2. The identification distance for NFC key card is within 1-2cm.

3. It is necessary to place the NFC key card in the designated area of the left side mirror to realise its identification.

4. The identification time may be 1\~2s.

### 5.19.1.2 System descriptions

1. This vehicle is equipped with a NFC system, through which the driver can unlock the door by swiping NFC key card.
2. The system is controlled by the NFC control module. This module verifies the near NFC key card that is detected by it, and emits operation signals to relevant executing ECU to complete the entire system work.
3. The detection system, independently controlled by the NFC control module, is used to detect the effective range of exterior rearview mirror surface.

### 5.19.4.2 DTC reading and clearing

Use VDS to read and clear the vehicle fault codes, and determine the current DTC to help maintenance personnel to test quickly.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select "VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system"→"Passenger car"→"EV series"→"New Tang EV
2021"→"New Tang EV 2021 General"→"ECU module"→"NFC control module (BYD)".

6. Read and clear the DTC.

![](images/fa4ec089c8322b3af79bfa7ca0a886b74821fa0e11a0d82aae3a73b2e894d15c.webp)

a. Select “Fault detection” to read DTC.
b. Select “Clear fault” to clear DTC.

### 5.19.4.3 Read data flow

According to the display on VDS, read the data flow of the current system, and read the working state information of the NFC system without disassembling any parts. Reading the data flow first when troubleshooting can improve work efficiency.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select "VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system"→"Passenger car"→"EV series"→"New Tang EV
2021"→"New Tang EV 2021 General"→"ECU module"→"NFC control module (BYD)".

6. Read data flow

a. Select “Data flow” to read the data flow.

### 5.20.2.1 Warnings and precautions

1. During installation, be sure to protect the wiring harness to avoid cutting, pulling or stepping on it.
2. During installation, the wiring harness should be kept away from liquids such as oil, water, as well as dirt.
3. All wiring harnesses should be installed in their original positions and fixed firmly, without shaking or hanging, interfering with force, or being damaged by friction.
4. All wiring harnesses must be fitted with the threading sheath properly when passing through the hole.
5. All harness connectors should be connected into place, and the GND points should be installed firmly.

### 6.1.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. When you need to enter the vehicle to work, be sure to cover the seats and other parts to avoid being stained with oil.

2. The interior trimming should be removed with a crow plate of interior trimming. If there is no crow plate, a screwdriver or equivalent can be used instead, but it should be wrapped.

3. Do not use sharp tools to remove interior trimming.

4. Since most interior trimmings are fixed by clips, it is necessary to ensure that all clips are pried out before removing interior trimmings.

5. Do not remove the interior trimming by force to avoid damage.

6. Be sure to check whether the fixing clips of parts are missing when installing parts, and add fixing clips if missing.

7. Check and replace all damaged clips.

8. The trimming part should be placed in a clean and flat position to avoid damaging its surface.

9. Be sure to perform thorough inspection before repair or replacement of parts.

10.After installation, the fasteners must be checked according to the specified torque.

11.During removal and installation of the front door assembly, an assistant should be required to avoid sudden falling of the front door assembly, resulting in personal injury and damage to vehicle.

12.During removal and installation of internal parts of the door sheet metal, please wear longsleeved work clothes and protective gloves to avoid being cut by sheet metal parts.

13.After repairing the door lock, it should be ensured that the door can be closed only when the door lock is open; otherwise the lock will be damaged.

14.Do not pull the wiring harness when disconnecting the connector, so as to prevent damage to the wiring harness.

### 1. Window regulation function:

a. The power window system regulates the window by operating the window regulator switch on the door trimming panel. The driver can regulate all windows through the front left door window regulator switch set.
b. The power window lock switch on the driver side front door trimming panel enables the driver to disable all passenger side window switches.
c. Only when the vehicle is powered on can the power window system work.
d. Automatic lowering feature: Pressing the window switch to the second position in the window lowering direction enables automatic lowering, and pulling up or pressing the switch in any direction during the lowering process stops window moving.
e. Automatic lifting feature: Pulling up the window switch to the second position in the window lifting direction enables automatic lifting, and pulling up or pressing the switch in any direction during the lifting process stops window moving.
f. Certain functions and features of the power window system depend on the control of their electronic modules integrated in the front left door window regulator switch component.
g. The power window system components include the window regulator switch and window regulator motor.

### 2. Delay function of power window:

a. Within 10min after the front door is closed and the vehicle is powered off, the window control switch can still work to control the window raising/lowering. Once any front door is opened, the delay function will be invalid.

### 3. Anti-pinch function of window:

a. The anti-pinch function is triggered when the window is obstructed by a large force while closing. In such case, the window will stop and automatically roll down to some extent.

### 4. Front left door control ECU

a. The front left door control ECU is a memory system component.
b. The main components of the memory system include left and right door control ECU, driver's seat assembly (driver's seat ECU, seat basin tilt adjustment motor, height adjustment motor, levelness adjustment motor and seat angle adjustment motor), and electric steering column (steering wheel position adjustment switch, axial adjustment motor and angle adjustment motor).
c. During power-on or power-off, the seats and electric steering column will activate the Welcoming feature.
d. The memory system allows a maximum of two positions to be memorized and stored.
e. The memory system must be set to allow the memory switch to be operated to store the position of any seat or side mirror only when the seat or side mirror does not move electrically.

### 6.1.7.2 DTC reading and clearing

Use VDS to read and clear the vehicle fault codes, and determine the current DTC to help maintenance personnel to test quickly.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module” → “Front left door control (Kostal)”
6. Read and clear the front left door control ECU DTC.

a. Select “Front left door control(Kostal)”

![](images/818cf0a63e70a54a7e0662c68d802ea98747999c84196ccdfad67a2ef613ca8c.webp)

b. Select “Fault detection” to read DTC.
c. Select “Clear fault” to clear DTC.

![](images/db55f47465322313e0594ad5a65157fb7aced5854518868f0794907ead7afe71.webp)

7. Read and clear the front right door control ECU DTC.

![](images/9a18bfaae4620b6483e114210a40ae3932483ca4bf07b7fab1df97c3f3b42b07.webp)

a. Select “Front right door control(Kostal)”

![](images/7499ed4283683daaf2ef12b97d48f2d5cf62cb02c3fd6d0414ff494f849e9415.webp)

b. Select “Fault detection” to read DTC.
c. Select “Clear fault” to clear DTC.

8. Read and clear the DTC of front left door window regulator switch set.

![](images/434b35907dd1200107ae0333a91d9d3f82da79523998e153ac64986120a0621d.webp)

a. Select “Car door multi-channel controller (Changjiang Electronics)”

![](images/1ebd892af957b87a97ef1a26bbf87a4707c2433eb79c2545fe917ecef971b093.webp)

b. Select “Fault detection” to read DTC.
c. Select “Clear fault” to clear DTC.

### 6.1.7.4 Action test

Without disassembling any parts, use VDS to conduct action test on the suspected parts, and then judge whether the suspected parts function normally. Active test when troubleshooting can avoid unnecessary disassembly and improve diagnosis efficiency and accuracy.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New
Tang EV 2021 ” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module”

6. Action test of front left door control ECU.

a. Select “Front left door control(Kostal)”

![](images/1b3172ffd9b8d8f3f287a903dc5d6bb30353132575bee9ed5577c21fd199ca04.webp)

b. Select "Action test" for performing action test.

![](images/4f6c5b6edb28d5f6b1cf59cae123e04771bd6d7e5534a30016d2cc530516c2cc.webp)

7. Action test of front right door control ECU.

![](images/e50e16ed7038ef9ce6c989fb72d301b515fa9e024b538784026c893968d29dcf.webp)

a. Select “Front right door control(Kostal)”

![](images/3be704fad902f2bc37e1589f43cad6c35057a0c545f636ed8e9f8add21ad83d2.webp)

b. Select "Action test" for performing action test.

8. Action test of the front left door window regulator switch set.

![](images/f59ecb814869864b76dec56c535078b4fc3cce6be09bae271d6e1187da4b7a53.webp)

a. Select “Car door multi-channel controller (Changjiang Electronics)”

![](images/c285bb9e00708e2c01694c69e4681bac4183004fad6959b6b2215a60a32fc81e.webp)

b. Select "Action test" for performing action test.

### Diagnostic steps

![](images/28c7074c388e65c5f84c2d306c0eced78ad60442fd18dde7f9c10fa7f81aa0d3.webp)

a. Read and clear the DTC. Refer to: DTC reading and clearing
b. Perform the test drive for functional inspection.
c. Check if the fault code exists.

Diagnose it as an occasional fault, and check whether the corresponding connector is loose or damaged, and whether the wiring harness terminal is corroded.

![](images/270e6eeb87f1383af1b68307e2e46ab997dd5ce925eb02c56500e6efed81bea1.webp)

a. Use VDS to check whether it can communicate with the driver s seat ECU.

No

Go to Step 4.

![](images/28c2261a9203cae1a17803f4ed579e3a9770c9fb13928b93bb5c476eaffd309d.webp)

a. Start the vehicle.
b. Check and adjust seat, and check whether the driver s seat works normally.
c. Check whether the result is normal?

Go to Step 9.

![](images/9d34ba3d0a7efd7b70a8c80d72c845364c5977bd9ef16bef33852d9dcc3c754a.webp)

![](images/d08086e702c4b3fea64e0c9bd07b22766dbf4cd1d189534bf3148d36368a7ad3.webp)

a. Check whether the fuses F2/19 and F2/30 in the dashboard distribution box are blown. Standard value:

![](images/98cf99572c337116607ac45a96133453d3c147185e8979ebee34ef0be5c5e8b5.webp)

Troubleshoot the system circuit short circuit, and then replace it with a fuse of the same specification.

No

![](images/cafec1c7ade622f966ced5fede44bf5667d28b64b3ecb639901f14d5b2711c6b.webp)

a. When the vehicle is OFF, disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery).
b. Disconnect the driver's seat assembly wiring harness connector K01.
c. Check the driver's seat assembly wiring harness or connector for corrosion, damage, or pin withdrawal.
d. Check the driver's seat ECU wiring harness or connector for corrosion, damage, or pin withdrawal.
e. Check whether the result is normal?

Replace the faulty wiring harness.

Yes

![](images/d428da0edd58b5e6ab64be8688de8ebbd4d35353f791ac17256b5062a6fdafee.webp)

![](images/899a866acb579ca38f8c14687747977325340202765a1aa8d213355b86118cad.webp)

a. Measure the resistance between the terminals 2/ 7/13 of K01 and GND with a digital multimeter. Resistance:

![](images/4259b29a760d5381a785d0ba12a6ace17e87bf4b9e12a2719dd3b4e7b6315173.webp)

b. Check whether the result is normal?

Repair or replace the GND wiring harness of the driver s seat assembly.

### Yes

![](images/484869a6455fb051ed7cf390a24b34d8440bb528d4ef4b652542c60f8959b743.webp)

![](images/4dd79e9007ff20b31793e5c718dd6325f1c79891751755a452d3af72f15e617a.webp)

a. Connect the driver's seat assembly wiring harness connector.
b. Connect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) and start the vehicle.
c. Measure the voltage between the terminals 2/7/ 13 of K01 and GND with a digital multimeter. Voltage:

![](images/500c17ad5849b5f0f662fc8c3e35d841698ec7a673af445bf523972890abcb76.webp)

d. Check whether the result is normal?

Check whether the GND point is loose, oxidized and corroded; If abnormal, repair it; If normal, replace the GND wiring harness of the driver s seat assembly.

### Yes

![](images/ce89e3a14c2a061d952252f17695d13efdcdedb714b6a88b7acddefdda405a84.webp)

![](images/2020959380346bc60aca911d6dc3f4687f78a2e8b2dac6b8e517523de5179319.webp)

a. Measure the voltage between the terminals 1/8/ 11 of K01 and GND with a digital multimeter. Voltage:

![](images/4d09585ba821ae018e3b60e0e4545893e2c58825ae0528b32a0349faed77053c.webp)

b. Check whether the result is normal?

Repair or replace the power supply wiring harness of the driver s seat assembly.

![](images/89fc671bee7fe4d00739d80087f56576dd1f7b6e2bc9db4747eaea2888adc6dd.webp)

a. Replace a new driver s seat ECU.

i Caution:

After replacing the driver s seat ECU, it is necessary to calibrate the driver's seat again. Refer to: Driver s seat calibration

b. Restore the vehicle, clear all module fault codes, and perform the test drive for functional inspection. c. Check whether the result is normal?

Troubleshooting.

No

![](images/499dc97a69c081d3ac9ebb206d518af1f19ea67e02d52d6ebd1600dc5eb18cfe.webp)

a. Replace a new front left door control ECU. b. Restore the vehicle, clear all module fault codes, and perform the test drive for functional inspection. c. Check whether the result is normal?

Troubleshooting.

Follow the above diagnostic steps and check again.

### Removal procedures

0 Tip:

This manual takes the adjustment of the front left door assembly as an example. For the adjustment of the front right door assembly, please refer to the left side.

1. Open the front door.
2. Adjustment of front door assembly

![](images/e93ae0497ae3715adb9dd6ec0052a1e33cb261ff1102360162c38e1515fbdee1.webp)

a. Loosen the 4 fixing bolts on the door side of the upper and lower hinges of the front door, and adjust the front door assembly horizontally and vertically.
b. After adjustment, tighten the fixing bolts. Torque: 26\~30N•m
c. Loosen the 2 fixing bolts of the front door lock ring assembly slightly, and tap the front door lock ring assembly lightly with a rubber hammer for adjustment.
d. After adjustment, tighten the fixing bolts. Torque: 21\~25N•m

### 6.1.9.1 Front door with accessory assembly

0 Tip:

This manual takes the removal and installation of the front left door with accessory assembly as an example. For the removal and installation of the front right door with accessory assembly, please refer to the left side.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the front left door with accessory assembly.

![](images/2dbf0efe8c4e942643b79a43002726f8a6ac0913486045ee4e5ea0cfa7231c39.webp)

a. Pull out the locking pin in the direction of arrow A, and disconnect the front door wiring harness connector in the direction of arrow B.

![](images/0c201be574a383fc22ea7c5252b64e969d0f5faae6a912c70475861fa67bc3da.webp)

b. Remove one fixing bolt A on the vehicle body side of front door limiting stopper assembly. Torque: 23±3N•m c. Remove the 2 fixing bolts B on the door side of front door lower hinge assembly.

Torque: 25N•m

i Caution: The door assembly is heavy, so an assistant is required to remove the bolts.

![](images/65167509a09630da8596a3d76de88c7e3b1433f418ef77088945d304f2cf105c.webp)

d. Remove the 2 fixing bolts B on the door side of front door upper hinge assembly, and take off the front door with accessory assembly.

Torque: 25N•m i Caution:

The door assembly is heavy, so an assistant is required to remove the bolts. The door assembly is heavy, so pay attention to safety when moving to avoid personal injury or damage to the door.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the front left door with accessory assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. When installing the front door with accessory assembly, install and pre-tighten the door hinge bolts, adjust the door position, and ensure uniform gaps around the door, and then tighten the hinge bolts.
b. Check that the door lock and lock ring are properly matched.

### 6.1.9.2 Front door upper hinge assembly

0 Tip:

This manual takes the removal and installation of the front left door upper hinge assembly as an example. For the removal and installation of the front right door upper hinge assembly, please refer to the left side.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the front left door with accessory assembly. Refer to: Front door with accessory assembly

2. Remove the front left door upper hinge assembly.

![](images/389ed00bce4046d4024bb14fdb7be9b0868bce0f9c51dbb38804cedb4fa0131b.webp)

a. Remove the 2 fixing bolts A and one fixing nut B, and take off the front left door upper hinge assembly.

Torque: 26\~30N•m

### Installation procedures

1. Install the front left door upper hinge assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. After disassembling/assembling the door hinge and installing the door, be sure to adjust the door position to ensure that the gaps around the door are uniform and the door lock and lock ring are properly matched.

### 6.1.9.3 Front door lower hinge assembly

0 Tip:

This manual takes the removal and installation of the front left door lower hinge assembly as an example. For the removal and installation of the front right door lower hinge assembly, please refer to the left side.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the front left door with accessory assembly. Refer to: Front door with accessory assembly
2. Remove the front left door lower hinge assembly.

![](images/44e50fac535ce06d02a844ff78bc9cdd260ef0c95811545f6c4e1125edf3d87d.webp)

a. Remove the 2 fixing bolts and take off the front left door lower hinge assembly. Torque: 26\~30N•m

### Installation procedures

1. Install the front left door lower hinge assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. After disassembling/assembling the door hinge and installing the door, be sure to adjust the door position to ensure that the gaps around the door are uniform and the door lock and lock ring are properly matched.

### 6.1.9.4 Front door limiting stopper assembly

0 Tip:

This manual takes the removal and installation of the front left door limiting stopper assembly as an example. For the removal and installation of the front right door limiting stopper assembly, please refer to the left side.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the front left door shield assembly. Refer to: Front door shield assembly
2. Remove the left low-pitched speaker (front door). Refer to: Low-pitched speaker (front door)
3. Remove the front left door limiting stopper assembly.

![](images/a6107f9148ca3cdeb5dea7fa3ead447ec2e11bb833760865c526750f669faa9c.webp)

a. Remove one fixing bolt A on the vehicle body side of front door limiting stopper assembly. Torque: 23±3N•m
b. Remove the 2 fixing nuts B on the door side of front door limiting stopper assembly. Torque: 10±1N•m
c. Remove the front door limiting stopper assembly.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the front left door limiting stopper assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items: a. Apply grease to the moving parts of the door limiting stopper.

### 6.1.9.5 Front glass guide rail assembly of front door

0 Tip:

This manual takes the removal and installation of the front glass guide rail assembly of front left door as an example. For the removal and installation of the front glass guide rail assembly of front right door, please refer to the left side.

### Removal procedures

1. Raise the door glass to the top.
2. Remove the front left door shield assembly. Refer to: Front door shield assembly
3. Remove the front left door waterproof film I. Refer to: Front door waterproof film I
4. Remove the front glass guide rail assembly of front left door.

![](images/418e7da65f135908d724c6b4b8e293909a90fa508c5d00ad2a2d3fabe3b956a7.webp)

a. Raise the glass to the highest position, remove 2 fixing bolts, and take off the front glass guide rail assembly of front left door. Torque: 9N•m

### Installation procedures

1. Install the front glass guide rail assembly of front left door in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. Before installing the guide rail, the A-pillar run channel lower section of the front door should be pre-clamped on the guide rail, and then installed in the door together.

### 6.1.9.6 Rear glass guide rail assembly of front door

0 Tip:

This manual takes the removal and installation of the rear glass guide rail assembly of front left door as an example. For the removal and installation of the rear glass guide rail assembly of front right door, please refer to the left side.

### Removal procedures

1. Raise the door glass to the top.
2. Remove the front left door shield assembly. Refer to: Front door shield assembly
3. Remove the front left door waterproof film Ⅱ. Refer to: Front door waterproof film Ⅱ

![](images/d602d03f22a0ff0c57902020dad3551c5504ea3e07dd55894f87f6b080779002.webp)

a. Raise the glass to the highest position, remove 2 fixing bolts, and take off the rear glass guide rail assembly of front left door. Torque: 9N•m

1. Install the rear glass guide rail assembly of front left door in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

### 6.1.9.7 Front door window regulator assembly

0 Tip:

This manual takes the removal and installation of the front left door window regulator assembly as an example. For the removal and installation of the front right door window regulator assembly, please refer to the left side.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the front left door shield assembly. Refer to: Front door shield assembly
2. Remove the front left door frame trim strip assembly. Refer to: Front door frame trim strip
assembly
3. Remove the inner weather strip of front left door. Refer to: Inner weather strip of front door
4. Remove the front left door waterproof film Refer to: Front door waterproof film I

6. Remove the rear glass guide rail assembly of front left door. Refer to: Rear glass guide rail
assembly of front door
7. Remove the front left door glass assembly. Refer to: Front door glass assembly
8. Remove front left door control ECU. Refer to: Front door control ECU

0 Tip:

![](images/25a5468c6ce99ef576ae07ee114aa93e9e73cbc68a5a774d9094c0ab07bc938b.webp)

![](images/4bf5cfe3f237d56672091a4319bd7a229e9f8d154daebdfd344b80b0ee022fcb.webp)

c. After installation, start the vehicle and check that the window regulator assembly should work properly.

### 6.1.9.9 Front door lock body assembly

0 Tip:

This manual takes the removal and installation of the front left door lock body assembly as an example. For the removal and installation of the front right door lock body assembly, please refer to the left side.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the front left door shield assembly. Refer to: Front door shield assembly
2. Remove the front left door waterproof film Ⅱ. Refer to: Front door waterproof film Ⅱ
3. Remove the rear glass guide rail assembly of front left door. Refer to: Rear glass guide rail assembly of front door
4. Remove the front left door lock body assembly. a. Disengage the through-hole rubber sleeve of inner handle cable.

b. Release the outer pull rod of front left door lock.

a. The connector should be installed in place.
b. The front door lock cylinder assembly and the front door lock body assembly should be connected correctly.
c. Check that unlocking with the mechanical key should be smooth.
d. After installation, check that the front door lock body assembly should work properly.

0 Tip:

![](images/c383eb32868496f18a836d779d57a07bfdc4cee098c23bac41762e2d734fe9ab.webp)

1. Install the front left door lock ring assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the front left door shield assembly. Refer to: Front door shield assembly
2. Remove the front left door waterproof film Ⅱ. Refer to: Front door waterproof film Ⅱ
3. Remove the front door lock cylinder assembly.

![](images/fade7fe5483b12d51d9cbf5e3178c755228f680a10abf39774621fdd2d84a034.webp)

g. Remove the gasket as required.

1. Install the front door lock cylinder assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

b. The connector should be installed in place.
c. After installation, use the mechanical key to unlock and lock the front left door normally.

### 6.2.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. When you need to enter the vehicle to work, be sure to cover the seats and other parts to avoid being stained with oil.

2. The interior trimming should be removed with a crow plate of interior trimming. If there is no crow plate, a screwdriver or equivalent can be used instead, but it should be wrapped.

3. Do not use sharp tools to remove interior trimming.

4. Since most interior trimmings are fixed by clips, it is necessary to ensure that all clips are pried out before removing interior trimmings.

5. Do not remove the interior trimming by force to avoid damage.

6. Be sure to check whether the fixing clips of parts are missing when installing parts, and add fixing clips if missing.

7. Check and replace all damaged clips.

8. The trimming part should be placed in a clean and flat position to avoid damaging its surface.

9. Be sure to perform thorough inspection before repair or replacement of parts.

10.After installation, the fasteners must be checked according to the specified torque.

11.During removal and installation of the rear door assembly, an assistant should be required to avoid sudden falling of the rear door assembly, resulting in personal injury and damage to vehicle.

12.In case of accidental blockage of power window during use, the power supply of 12V battery (starter Fe battery) should be cut off in time to prevent the window regulator motor from burning out.

13.During removal and installation of internal parts of the door sheet metal, please wear longsleeved work clothes and protective gloves to avoid being cut by sheet metal parts.

14.After repairing the door lock, it should be ensured that the door can be closed only when the door lock is open; otherwise the lock will be damaged.

15.Do not pull the wiring harness when disconnecting the connector, so as to prevent damage to the wiring harness.

### 6.2.7.2 DTC reading and clearing

Use VDS to read and clear the vehicle fault codes, and determine the current DTC to help maintenance personnel to test quickly.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New
Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module”
6. Read and clear the DTC of front left door window regulator switch set.

![](images/dedbbbaf82a59587b72d06f3e2f6df4ab4938d4ee72cc44e4ba209576e2d2b75.webp)

a. Select “Car door multi-channel controller (Changjiang Electronics)”

![](images/3344b5a875acf2d4afe36b7e85880ed67901d57645365e592aafedd6fb540f2f.webp)

b. Select “Fault detection” to read DTC.
c. Select “Clear fault” to clear DTC.

### Removal procedures

0 Tip:

This manual takes the adjustment of the rear left door assembly as an example. For the adjustment of the rear right door assembly, please refer to the left side.

1. Open the front door.
2. Adjustment of rear door assembly

![](images/8a3fe74ce22891bc2e4116e379920f800a2b1a948126568b9922e7377a51aa84.webp)

a. Loosen the 2 fixing bolts on the vehicle body side of the rear door upper hinge.

![](images/17b6f7bc8a7a149c8978ba47eccd59d6b86973cc36c2e5dde16d695037306eb9.webp)

b. Loosen the 2 fixing bolts A and one fixing nut B on the vehicle body side of the rear door lower hinge, and adjust the rear door assembly horizontally and vertically.
c. After adjustment, tighten the fixing bolts and nuts of upper and lower hinges. Torque: 26\~30N•m
d. Loosen the 2 fixing bolts of the rear door lock ring assembly slightly, and tap the rear door lock ring assembly lightly with a rubber hammer for adjustment.
e. After adjustment, tighten the fixing bolts. Torque: 21\~25N•m

![](images/2eb6453f93740c064627ebcb639a695b0b4a9d7ac218342aab9027a52a4d91d3.webp)

### 6.2.9.1 Rear door with accessory assembly

0 Tip:

This manual takes the removal and installation of the rear left door with accessory assembly as an example. For the removal and installation of the rear right door with accessory assembly, please refer to the left side.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the front left door sill shield assembly. Refer to: Front door sill shield assembly
2. Remove the rear left door sill shield assembly. Refer to: Rear door sill shield assembly
3. Remove the left B-pillar lower shield assembly. Refer to: B-pillar lower shield assembly
4. Remove the rear door with accessory assembly.

![](images/28e80800ddce21b922df8b9793827b0b4716080bc346edf7f3620ce31a217de7.webp)

a. Disconnect the door wiring harness connector and remove the wiring harness through-hole rubber sleeve.

b. Remove one fixing bolt on the vehicle body side of the door limiting stopper. Torque: 23±3N•m

![](images/0170e524c46a7eee67ec26cb2115f7f31518b6ecb1a2a021b8c78216e97a6493.webp)

c. Remove the 2 fixing bolts on the door side of the lower door hinge.

Torque: 26\~30N•m

Caution:

The door assembly is heavy, so an assistant is required to remove the bolts.

d. Remove the 2 fixing bolts on the door side of the upper door hinge, and take off the rear door with accessory assembly.

Torque: 26\~30N•m i Caution:

The door assembly is heavy, so an assistant is required to remove the bolts. The door assembly is heavy, so pay attention to safety when moving to avoid personal injury or damage to the door.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the rear door with accessory assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. The wiring harness through-hole rubber sleeve should be installed in place.
b. When installing the rear door with accessory assembly, first install the door hinge bolts, adjust the door position, and ensure uniform gaps around the door, and then tighten the hinge bolts.
c. Check that the door lock and lock ring are properly matched.

### 6.2.9.2 Rear door upper hinge assembly

0 Tip:

This manual takes the removal and installation of the rear left door upper hinge assembly as an example. For the removal and installation of the rear right door upper hinge assembly, please refer to the left side.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the rear door upper hinge assembly.

![](images/303a8b4b2195c0d463732ed534b03f85385c1d6d329bd4adbda81558d1384e98.webp)

a. Remove the 2 fixing bolts A and 2 fixing bolts B, and take off the rear left door upper hinge assembly.

Torque of bolt A: 26\~30N•m

i Caution:

When removing the hinge, an assistant is required to fix the door.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the rear door upper hinge assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. After installation, make sure that the gaps around the door are uniform.
b. Check that the door lock and lock ring are properly matched.

### 6.2.9.3 Rear door lower hinge assembly

0 Tip:

This manual takes the removal and installation of the rear left door lower hinge assembly as an example. For the removal and installation of the rear right door lower hinge assembly, please refer to the left side.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the rear door lower hinge assembly.

![](images/d9b0334b3a69cd0f2c90b67ec0cd177ca4937950f117295763e44c88e98efff8.webp)

a. Remove the 2 fixing bolts A, one fixing nut B and 2 fixing bolts C, and take off the rear left door lower hinge assembly.

Torque of bolt A: 26\~30N•m Torque of nut B: 26\~30N•m Torque of bolt C: 26\~30N•m

i Caution:

When removing the hinge, an assistant is required to fix the door.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the rear door lower hinge assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. Adjust the rear door assembly to ensure uniform gaps around the door.
b. Check that the door lock and lock ring are properly matched.

0 Tip:

1. Remove the rear left door shield assembly. Refer to: Rear door shield assembly

### Installation procedures

1. Install the rear left door limiting stopper assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. Apply grease to the moving parts of the door limiting stopper.

### 6.3.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. Be sure to perform thorough inspection before repair or replacement of parts.

2. Try to keep the working environment clean while working to prevent foreign matter from entering the parts.
3. When removing and installing the air spring, be sure to firmly support or lift the bonnet to avoid damage to components or even personal injury caused by the falling.
4. After removing and installing the bonnet or hinge, be sure to adjust the relative position of the bonnet.
5. After removing and installing the bonnet lock, be sure to adjust its relative position.
6. After installation, the fasteners must be checked according to the tightening torque.

### Removal procedures

1. Open the bonnet.
2. Adjust the bonnet.

![](images/4694c7ec89cf65420a19569475dc19daaa7fe996a109f1fdb5463179a47d83d8.webp)

a. Loosen the 4 fixing bolts (2 pcs for the left and right sides each), and adjust the bonnet to a reasonable range.
b. After adjustment, tighten the fixing bolts. Torque: 22\~28N•m
c. Adjust the front end of the bonnet through the bonnet upper buffer block, and adjust the bonnet to be flush with the fender through the upper buffer block of coolant tank upper beam connecting plate.

### Removal procedures

1. Open the bonnet.

2. Remove the front left/right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly
3. Remove the grille upper cover assembly. Refer to: Grille upper cover assembly
4. Adjustment of bonnet lock
a. Loosen the 3 fixing bolts and adjust the bonnet lock to a reasonable position.
b. After adjustment, tighten the fixing bolts. Torque: 10N•m

![](images/58bff18d14931f2b266f0dc2ac769b5efa63410eb06cbb13abd2f9d46ddc8d02.webp)

5. Install the grille upper cover assembly. Refer to: Grille upper cover assembly 6. Install the front left/right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the bonnet heat insulator. Refer to: Bonnet heat insulator
2. Remove the bonnet with accessory assembly.

![](images/4d74d1d6e59718814bc59f7b4e1a3797ee9ddbf1979e4676bfa9e1a4ac89fc7d.webp)

a. Disconnect washer hose.

![](images/3864170f0391ff2648c0541408695f2227d8b28fc7bd0606954e8438dcfb3e7d.webp)

b. Detach the upper end of bonnet air spring body on both sides.

### 0 Tip:

To remove the upper end of bonnet air spring body, arrange one person to lift the bonnet to prevent it from falling off, and arrange another person to gently pry the spring piece to a certain height using a tool and meanwhile pull out the air spring rod.

![](images/232b2b44065498a3b2d7f9e34e023e63a1c1ce3dbccfcdfc9d24586c335ba339.webp)

c. Remove the 4 fixing bolts (2 pcs for the left and right sides each), and remove the bonnet with accessory assembly.

### i Caution:

The bonnet with accessory assembly is heavy, so an assistant is required to remove it, so as to avoid damage to the body parts and glass.

Torque: 22\~28N•m

### Installation procedures

1. Install the bonnet with accessory assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. Adjust the bonnet assembly. Refer to: Adjustment of bonnet assembly

1. Be sure to perform thorough inspection before repair or replacement of parts.

2. After installation, the fasteners must be checked according to the specified torque.

3. During removal and installation of the boot lid assembly, an assistant should be required to avoid sudden falling of the boot lid assembly, resulting in personal injury and damage to vehicle.
4. During removal and installation of internal parts of the boot lid sheet metal, please wear long-sleeved work clothes and protective gloves to avoid being cut by sheet metal parts.
5. After repairing the door lock, it should be ensured that the door can be closed only when the door lock is open; otherwise the lock will be damaged.
6. Do not pull the wiring harness when disconnecting the connector, so as to prevent damage to the wiring harness.

### 1. System overview

a. The power boot lid is mainly composed of power boot lid control ECU, boot lid lock body assembly, boot lid lock actuator assembly, left electric spring body of boot lid, right electric spring body of boot lid, power boot lid closing switch assembly and hands-free boot lid opening system by kicking action.

2. The following functions can be realized.

a. Electric opening, closing and suspension of boot lid.
b. Electric closing and locking of boot lid.
c. Initialisation of boot lid.
d. Opening height setting of boot lid.
e. Anti-pinch function of boot lid.
f. Hands-free opening, closing and suspension of boot lid by kicking action.
g. Emergency unlocking of boot lid.

### 6.4.7.2 Read data flow

According to the display on VDS, read the data flow of the current system, and read the working state information of the power boot lid without disassembling any parts. Reading the data flow first when troubleshooting can improve work efficiency.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module” → “Power trunk lid (BYD)”

6. Read data flow

a. Select “Data flow” to read the data flow.

![](images/1cd28d01fef294cdd15d70b2a323c53ba9a94607b21e31f692ada54e79500063.webp)

### 6.4.7.3 Action test

Without disassembling any parts, use VDS to conduct action test on the suspected parts, and then judge whether the suspected parts function normally. Active test when troubleshooting can avoid unnecessary disassembly and improve diagnosis efficiency and accuracy.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module” → “Power trunk lid (BYD)”

6. Action test.

a. Select "Action test" for performing action test.

### Removal procedures

1. Open the boot lid.
2. Adjustment of boot lid assembly

![](images/647bbde0dc41936980370bf5fa30acff05db4762be2f20fccef4833da97ae71b.webp)

a. Loosen the 4 fixing bolts on the boot lid side of the boot lid hinge, and adjust the boot lid assembly horizontally and vertically. b. After adjustment, tighten the fixing bolts. Torque: 22\~28N•m

c. Remove the boot sill pedal assembly. Refer to: Boot sill pedal assembly

![](images/cdd4b561c489b1dae8a0f555d9bf5bf6dd3d213690c2a4f62c4bfd5c4106c4c9.webp)

d. Loosen the 2 fixing bolts of the boot lid lock body assembly, and tap the boot lid lock body assembly lightly with a rubber hammer for adjustment.
e. After adjustment, tighten the fixing bolts. Torque: 18\~22N•m

f. Install the boot sill pedal assembly. Refer to: Boot sill pedal assembly

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the middle toolkit assembly of boot. Refer to: Middle toolkit assembly of boot
2. Remove the rear left/right door sill shield assembly. Refer to: Rear door sill shield assembly
3. Remove the lower shield assembly of pillar C on the left and right sides. Refer to: Lower shield assembly of pillar C
4. Remove the upper shield assembly of pillar C on the left and right sides. Refer to: Upper shield assembly of pillar C
5. Remove the roof strip assembly of rear left/right side wall. Refer to: Roof strip assembly of rear side wall
6. Remove the rear interior light assembly. Refer to: Rear interior light assembly
7. Remove the rear left/right roof handle assembly. Refer to: Roof handle assembly
8. Remove the boot lid with accessory assembly.

![](images/7253df21de2476fff26e262616e2c45143bd341888c5b30b4d0553cc94a872a7.webp)

a. Remove one fixing bolt in the mounting hole of the rear interior light assembly. Torque: 5N•m

![](images/86b96951d25dd61cb526f23d5843474e0ff3f802b61e0fe26f765c4061b1460f.webp)

b. Pry up the clips (3 pieces) behind the roof and open the rear end of the roof.

i Caution: Do not bend the roof excessively to avoid creases.

![](images/20a331c58a3e364d7d581630ced6537c7fe7f42b7630a9431417529e12a9e8a4.webp)

Disconnect the washing pipe A, disconnect 2 connectors B/C, remove 2 fixing bolts D/E at GND point, and pass through the boot lid wiring harness.

Torque: 9±1N•m

![](images/c409b304d39b8ed9f50aa3d0fff175d04ad2c404d72a10d617707cb7471d0ce3.webp)

d. Disconnect the boot lid electric spring body on both sides from the boot lid assembly.

### ！ Warning:

The boot lid assembly is heavy, so 2 assistants are required to assist in disassembly to avoid personal injury or damage to vehicle caused by falling off of the boot lid.

![](images/4f5be7b22f0cee60eab7a49ae7f578ebf460e5047c73e69e31e0cecfea4e4fa5.webp)

e. Remove the 2 fixing bolts (4 bolts on both sides) of the boot lid hinge, and take off the boot lid with accessory assembly. Torque: 22\~28N•m

### Installation procedures

1. Install the boot lid with accessory assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. When installing the boot lid with accessory assembly, first install the boot lid hinge bolts, adjust the position of boot lid, and ensure uniform gaps around the boot lid, and then tighten the hinge bolts.
b. Check that the door lock and lock ring are properly matched.

### 6.4.9.2 Boot lid hinge assembly

0 Tip:

This manual takes the removal and installation of the left hinge assembly of boot lid as an example. For the removal and installation of the right hinge assembly of boot lid, please refer to the left side.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the rear left/right door sill shield assembly. Refer to: Rear door sill shield assembly
2. Remove the lower shield assembly of pillar C on the left and right sides. Refer to: Lower shield assembly of pillar C
3. Remove the upper shield assembly of pillar C on the left and right sides. Refer to: Upper shield assembly of pillar C

0 Tip: There is no need to remove the fixing bolts at the lower end of the seat belt, just remove the upper shield of pillar C.

4. Remove the roof strip assembly of rear left/right side wall. Refer to: Roof strip assembly of rear side wall

5. Remove the rear interior light assembly. Refer to: Rear interior light assembly

6. Remove the left hinge assembly of boot lid.

![](images/ddc4436602c78afd1362d55b584a28b367b76fdc9a9c346f02c8781dcd7735ce.webp)

a. Remove one fixing bolt in the mounting hole of the rear interior light assembly. Torque: 5N•m

![](images/79cd7c34dbdbcd024adcf794aff98747af67daa5563a3c789a5573dd71ffb163.webp)

b. Pry up the clips (3 pieces) behind the roof and open the rear end of the roof to expose the boot lid hinge.

i Caution: Do not bend the roof excessively to avoid creases.

![](images/bf7526096e71213cb0b079cd7408408bbfc010d924aeb3883dd9c9b5caa1f6aa.webp)

c. Remove the 2 fixing bolts A on the door side of the boot lid hinge, remove the 2 fixing nuts B on the vehicle body side of the boot lid hinge, and take off the boot lid hinge.

Torque of bolt A: 22\~28N•m Torque of nut B: 25N•m

### A Warning:

The boot lid assembly is heavy, so an assistant is required during operation, and attention should be paid to personal safety.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the left hinge assembly of boot lid in an order reverse to its removal.

a. Adjust the position of boot lid, and ensure uniform gaps around the boot lid, and then tighten the hinge bolts.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the engine trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Engine trimming panel assembly 2. Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). Refer to: Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery)

3. Remove the power boot lid control ECU.

![](images/94120ec1347920feb52d133673eb11fdd9fa0adf8b764d415467eec85fb6780d.webp)

a. Pry out the deep low-pitched speaker cover.

![](images/3ca4bbf4a3a13f510d9d125b6caeee48f362bcdf6a2157064392090a14941cc3.webp)

b. Disconnect the backup power supply connector and remove the deep low-pitched speaker cover assembly.

![](images/123799b880d95bcaeb93396eec67b53e140d40f4195f1c026cefade70788855c.webp)

c. Remove the 2 fixing bolts. Torque: 8N•m

![](images/648f2b184aae2587f95fbf3ac45bf8aad6609c9905c29b5fcf9bacb6b699acbc.webp)

d. Disconnect 2 connectors and remove the power boot lid control ECU.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the power boot lid control ECU in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. The connector should be installed in place.
b. After installation, check that the power boot lid should work properly.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the rear left/right combination light assembly. Refer to: Rear combination light assembly

2. Remove the rear left/right wheel eyebrow trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Rear wheel eyebrow trimming panel assembly

3. Remove the rear bumper assembly. Refer to: Rear bumper assembly

4. Remove the hands-free boot lid opening system by kicking action.

![](images/d3a69d215d05a24b7f5479791f525984c738957c46f5ad2334276ffc6ec81422.webp)

a. Disconnect connectors A and B, remove the 2 fixing screws C, and take off the hands-free boot lid opening controller ① by kicking action.
b. Detach each wiring harness fixing clip of the hands-free opening sensor by kicking action, and remove the hands-free opening sensor ② by kicking action.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the hands-free boot lid opening system by kicking action in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. The connector should be installed in place.
b. After installation, check that the hands-free boot lid opening system by kicking action should work properly.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the sealing strip of boot lid frame.

![](images/e5c2cea4ce795e7f9b4902200fa1f8f7f48d0db133f70f7911ea4920518970df.webp)

a. Hold the sealing strip joint (bottom of the holding position), slowly pull it outward with force, and pull out the sealing strip along one side of the strip.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the sealing strip of boot lid frame in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. When installing, make sure that the door frame sealing strip and sheet metal fit correctly.

1. Install the boot lid lock ring in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. During installation, pay attention to adjusting the position of the lock ring before fastening the bolts to ensure accurate matching with the door lock.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the middle toolkit assembly of boot. Refer to: Middle toolkit assembly of boot
2. Remove the boot sill pedal assembly. Refer to: Boot sill pedal assembly
3. Remove the boot lid lock actuator assembly.

d. Remove the boot lid lock actuator assembly.

1. Install the boot lid lock actuator assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items: a. Ensure that cables and connectors are installed in place.

1. Remove the rear left/right door sill shield assembly. Refer to: Rear door sill shield assembly

2. Remove the lower shield assembly of pillar C on the left and right sides. Refer to: Lower shield assembly of pillar C

0 Tip: There is no need to remove the fixing bolts at the lower end of the seat belt, just remove the upper shield of pillar C.

4. Remove the roof strip assembly of rear left/right side wall. Refer to: Roof strip assembly of rear side wall

5. Remove the rear interior light assembly. Refer to: Rear interior light assembly

6. Remove the rear left/right roof handle assembly. Refer to: Roof handle assembly

Torque: 8±1N•m

1. Install the left electric spring body of boot lid in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

a. The connector should be installed in place.
b. After installation, check that the power boot lid should function normally.

1. Remove the rear left/right door sill shield assembly. Refer to: Rear door sill shield assembly

2. Remove the lower shield assembly of pillar C on the left and right sides. Refer to: Lower shield assembly of pillar C

b. Pry up the clips (3 pieces) behind the roof and open the rear end of the roof to expose the right electric spring body connector of boot lid.

![](images/029efda2de7dc16fcd5c6ce914f3621467195de25df6c05e2c4ae636b00bd38f.webp)

c. Disconnect the connector and thread the wiring harness out.

![](images/d2cc81a49c1671e4854c777835e0b01631e703f7351b9db506475a9f71a30452.webp)

d. Detach both ends of the right electric spring body of boot lid, and remove the right electric spring body of boot lid.

### 0 Tip:

Slightly pry up the metal reed at the end to detach the electric spring body outward.

A Warning: The support force of one side brace is insufficient, so an assistant is required to support the boot lid assembly during disassembly to avoid pinch injury.

![](images/8d5193d1959b4ec01fd4237854019bbe8a09a7e467e7dd4f241b6444219788c5.webp)

e. If necessary, remove the 2 fixing bolts and take off the vehicle body bracket for right electric spring of boot lid. Torque: 8±1N•m

![](images/503594b878e7d7d13e1b61f695e300fc9e3573cb6a9143587229975fcb4f88e0.webp)

f. If necessary, remove the 2 fixing bolts and take off the door bracket for right electric spring of boot lid.

Torque: 8±1N•m

1. Install the right electric spring body of boot lid in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following items:

b. After installation, check that the power boot lid should function normally.

### 7.1.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. Be sure to perform thorough inspection before repair or replacement of parts.

2. Arrange an assistant to assist in removal and installation of the front/rear bumper. Take care not to scratch the front bumper and the vehicle body. Wear gloves to protect your hands.
3. Try to keep the working environment clean while working to prevent foreign matters from entering the parts.
4. Be careful to remove and install the bumper to avoid scratching the paint.
5. Be careful to release the clip tongues on both sides of the bumper to avoid damage to the bumper.
6. After installation, the fasteners must be checked according to the tightening torque.
7. After removing and installing the front bumper, rear bumper and front and rear cameras, check that the panoramic view stitching effect is normal. If not, perform the panoramic camera calibration.
8. After removing and installing the front and rear bumpers, road test should be conducted to check whether the front millimeter wave radar and rear millimeter wave radar work normally. If not, perform calibration again.

### Removal procedures

4. Remove the front bumper assembly a. Disconnect the front compartment lock connector.

![](images/3c250ceba8951592edece4d585603c1bc7bb855048a8598ad1c8bfea40631507.webp)

e. Remove the 4 fixing bolts A and 2 fixing screws B under the front bumper. Torque of bolt A: 5N•m

f. Detach the connection between the bumper and bumper bracket, and remove the front bumper.

Be careful to release the clip tongues on both sides to avoid damage to the front bumper.

![](images/9c6fca9d2456de55ceb677c5fee136c0d06b9151f927322744ce41112a0dba24.webp)

### Disassembly and assembly

1. Remove energy absorbing foam of front bumper

a. Disconnect the connector A, disconnect the small probe bracket and remove the small probe ①.

a. Remove the 3 fixing screws, disconnect the clip tongue, and remove the front grille assembly.

### Assembly procedure

1. Assemble the front bumper assembly in an order reverse to its disassembly and pay attention to the following: a. Replace the metal circlip.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the front bumper assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

a. Confirm that all connectors are installed in place.
b. Pay attention to the fitting between the front bumper assembly and the clamping pin of the left & right headlights during assembly.
c. Confirm that the front bumper is reliably fitted with its left and right brackets and headlight.
d. Confirm the fitting between the front bumper and the front motor lower mudguard assembly (the front bumper is at the bottom).

0 Tip:

For the removal and installation of the right bracket assembly of rear bumper, please refer to the left side. 1. Remove the rear left/right combination light assembly. ### Removal procedures

1. Remove the rear left/right combination light assembly. Refer to: Rear combination light assembly

2. Remove the rear left/right wheel eyebrow trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Rear wheel eyebrow trimming panel assembly

3. Remove the rear bumper assembly

![](images/4b91d9a77ef0bfd8b59dac2f635a1284b83f9ec75c61afb781871d44d393ead0.webp)

1. The interior trimming should be removed with a skid plate of interior trimming. If there is no skid plate, a screwdriver or equivalent can be used instead, but it should be wrapped.

3. Since most interior trimmings are fixed by platic clips, it is necessary to ensure that all clips are removed before removing interior trimmings.

8. The connector should be firmly connected, without virtual connection or terminal bending, and be locked in place for the second time.

o. Remove the 2 fixing bolts A connected with the HVAC assembly. Torque: 6 N•m.

q. Remove the 1 fixing bolts A connected with the HVAC assembly. Torque: 6 N•m.

y. Take out the tubular beam welding assembly with wiring harness assembly.

A Warning: Since the tubular beam assembly is heavy and the bracket is sharp, be careful to take protective measures when taking it out to avoid personal injury or damage to the vehicle.
i Caution: Check the connection between the tubular beam with wiring harness assembly and the vehicle body again, disengage all wiring harness fixing clips, and ensure that there is no redundant connection. Remove the dashboard wiring harness assembly as required.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the tubular beam welding assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

b. The connector should be installed in place.
c. Be careful not to squeeze the wiring harness during installation to avoid damage.

### 7.5.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. The interior trimming should be removed with a skid plate of interior trimming. If there is no skid plate, a screwdriver or equivalent can be used instead, but it should be wrapped.

2. Do not use sharp tools to remove interior trimming.

3. Since most interior trimmings are fixed by platic clips, it is necessary to ensure that all clips are removed before removing interior trimmings.

4. Do not remove the interior trimming by force to avoid damage.

5. Be sure to check whether the fixing clips of parts are missing when installing parts, and add qualified fixing clips if missing.

6. The interior trimmings should be placed in a clean and flat position to avoid rubbing its surface.

7. Check and replace all damaged fixing clips.

8. The connector should be firmly connected, without virtual connection or terminal bending, and be locked in place for the second time.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the rear trimming panel assembly of auxiliary dashboard. Refer to: Rear trimming panel assembly of auxiliary dashboard
2. Remove the gearshift control mechanism cover assembly. Refer to: Gearshift control mechanism cover assembly
3. Remove the gearshift control mechanism assembly. Refer to: Gearshift control mechanism assembly

4. Remove the auxiliary dashboard body assembly a. Remove the 3 fixing screws, and take off the rearrow face level air duct assembly Ⅳ.

![](images/a0fab67716c033632bd2b7c9b05eb2b8de5300a43b12a71ed3c6469b5408babb.webp)

e. Push out the backup power supply ① upwards.

0 Tip: Push out the backup power supply chip first, and then push out the backup power supply socket.

f. Push out the USB port assembly ② upwards.

g. Take out the rubber pads of the auxiliary dashboard armrest box. h. Remove the 2 fixing screws, and pull out the glovebox in the auxiliary dashboard armrest box upwards (2 metal clip tongues).

![](images/2553fca18c5f385d940fe32ec050b808a9914f1c4983ea066c6eaf7d55f7a543.webp)

i. Remove the 6 fixing bolts of the auxiliary dashboard frame, disengage each wiring harness clip, and remove the auxiliary dashboard body. Torque: 6 N•m.

0 Tip:

There are many wiring harness clips, so be sure to record the position of wiring harness clips to facilitate installation.

7.6.5.16 Left charging port trimming cover assembly   2616

### 7.6.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. The interior trimming should be removed with a skid plate of interior trimming. If there is no skid plate, a screwdriver or equivalent can be used instead, but it should be wrapped.

2. Do not use sharp tools to remove interior trimming.

3. Since most interior trimmings are fixed by platic clips, it is necessary to ensure that all clips are removed before removing interior trimmings.

4. Do not remove the interior trimming by force to avoid damage.

5. Be sure to check whether the fixing clips of parts are missing when installing parts, and add qualified fixing clips if missing.

6. The interior trimmings should be placed in a clean and flat position to avoid rubbing its surface.

7. Check and replace all damaged fixing clips.

### 7.7.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. The interior trimming should be removed with a skid plate of interior trimming. If there is no skid plate, a screwdriver or equivalent can be used instead, but it should be wrapped.

2. Do not use sharp tools to remove interior trimming.

3. Since most interior trimmings are fixed by plastic clips, it is necessary to ensure that all clips are removed before removing interior trimmings.

4. Do not remove the interior trimming by force to avoid damage.

5. Be sure to check whether the fixing clips of parts are missing when installing parts, and add qualified fixing clips if missing.

6. The interior trimmings should be placed in a clean and flat position to avoid rubbing its surface.

7. Check and replace all damaged fixing clips.

a. Pry up 8 clip tongues and remove the front left door high-pitched speaker cover.

![](images/42d97bba72f4efb9d69210143e94d47531f157a780aa47005cb523830b368871.webp)

b. Remove the 3 fixing screws of the front door shield assembly.

![](images/f544d088901c5f89d2dbb9aa679348ed67206df52fa2bacf04589bbf0d98643b.webp)

c. Pry up 10 fixing clips and remove the front door shield assembly.

### 0 Tip:

For easy disassembly, the window glass can be lowered.
At this time, the door shield is constrained by wiring harness and cannot be pulled too far. Apply force evenly when prying the clips of front door shield to prevent the front door shield from being damaged by excessive force. It is preferred to insert a tool from the nonappearance side of the front door shield (near the door hinge side).

![](images/acab924253f467b9440f7b2168e3c8bb0cba0ef5c1fe7300d34c397694e4aa25.webp)

d. Disconnect the door inner handle cable.

![](images/c468b7d3fa50766ad8bf03aa6c31764a266991841d48227a785386a5cb664157.webp)

![](images/ec2468730a36d8ca86544ec762e3d28848044b9ce85e47c43bbed5d11d3fcdde.webp)

f. Disconnect the connector A of left door handle ambient light.
g. Disconnect the connector B of front left position memory switch (only for the front left door).
h. Disconnect the high-pitched speaker connector C.
i. Disconnect the connector D of anti-theft warning indicator (only for the front left door).
j. Disconnect the connector (front) E of front left door ambient light assembly.
k. Disengage the fixing clip F of side-view camera wiring harness.
l. Disconnect the connector of #6 switch set (only for the front left door).

![](images/3a9ca11f84f0c3fda49e015d23b8cd9f128d25e9ab3006579ac16678a7f7795c.webp)

![](images/075d7eb8e4dabc12799df436fc01bc574603594fcff5345c4aabd3c76f97f955.webp)

![](images/d64a8b4628c2f4e027585ec2a3a375c6cec51bbb9497c97a83aae77cd2a00bf4.webp)

n. Disconnect the connector of left door light. o. Remove the front left door shield assembly. p. Remove other accessories on the front door shield assembly as required.

### 7.9.2.1 Warnings and precautions

1. The interior trimming should be removed with a skid plate of interior trimming. If there is no skid plate, a screwdriver or equivalent can be used instead, but it should be wrapped.

2. Do not use sharp tools to remove interior trimming.

3. Since most interior trimmings are fixed by plastic clips, it is necessary to ensure that all clips are removed before removing interior trimmings.

4. Do not remove the interior trimming by force to avoid damage.

5. Be sure to check whether the fixing clips of parts are missing when installing parts, and add qualified fixing clips if missing.

6. The interior trimmings should be placed in a clean and flat position to avoid rubbing its surface.

7. Check and replace all damaged fixing clips.

5. Remove the left and right sun visor assemblies. Refer to: Sun visor assembly
6. Remove the left and right vanity mirror lights. Refer to: Vanity mirror light
7. Remove the lower left shield assembly of dashboard. Refer to: Lower left shield assembly of dashboard
8. Remove the front left and right door sill shield assemblies. Refer to: Front door sill shield assembly
9. Remove the rear left/right door sill shield assembly. Refer to: Rear door sill shield assembly
10.Remove the left and right B-pillar lower shield assemblies. Refer to: B-pillar lower shield assembly
11.Remove the upper shield assembly of pillar B on the left and right sides. Refer to: Upper shield assembly of pillar B
12.Remove the middle toolkit assembly of boot. Refer to: Middle toolkit assembly of boot
13.Remove the left and right C-pillar lower shield assemblies. Refer to: C-pillar lower shield assembly
14.Remove the left/right C-pillar upper shield assembly. Refer to: C-pillar upper shield assembly
15.Remove the roof strip assembly of rear left/right side wall. Refer to: Roof strip assembly of rear side wall
16.Remove the front right, rear left and rear right roof handle assemblies. Refer to: Roof handle assembly
17.Remove the rear interior light assembly. Refer to: Rear interior light assembly
18.Remove the roof assembly.

a. Disconnect the washing pipe at the right pillar A.

![](images/b837f16e98a3f4fd79839f7adc78ecc232fd668aec9b55c418dd31ee39769eed.webp)

![](images/833b407353f68e6d4e1da73fce70c8e690a4ca8c14ec0c5c7ce98179576b0164.webp)

b. Disconnect the washing pipe at the right pillar D.

![](images/b3edd460248872b011d22393c70a6b12f30f3ec7689984c519d458bbf4be01c0.webp)

c. Remove the 4 fixing bolts in the mounting position of the front roof light. Torque: 5N•m

d. Remove one fixing bolt in the mounting hole of the rear interior light assembly. Torque: 5N•m

![](images/52d850cbde1292d4745393f63675b500fe71880e503e3f87338229c3c8e4f034.webp)

e. Pry up the 3 fixing clips at the rear, disengage downward and take out the roof assembly.

### 0 Tip:

Use 20 dual locks around the sunroof and disengage them downward.
When removing the roof assembly, an assistant is required to avoid bending and damaging the roof or soiling the roof assembly.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the roof assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

a. In order to ensure the fitting clearance between the roof and the shield, relevant foam mats are stuck on the roof. During installation, be sure to check whether the foam mats at relevant positions fall off, and re-stick them if so.

### 7.12.6.2 DTC reading and clearing

Use VDS to read and clear the vehicle fault codes, and determine the current DTC to help maintenance personnel to test quickly.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New
Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module” → “Driver s seat(BYD)”
6. Read and clear the DTC.

![](images/022af824d1043ad14a45a1a6eab9e9147a580d9561ac8d55c10fcedd95748518.webp)

a. Select “Fault detection” to read DTC.

### 7.12.6.3 Read data flow

According to the display on VDS, read the data flow of the current system, and read the working state information of the seat system without disassembling any parts. Reading the data flow first when troubleshooting can improve work efficiency.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New
Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module” → “Driver s seat(BYD)”
6. Read data flow

a. Select “Data flow” to read the data flow.

![](images/1602cc8b43a64957a75c3b8f8b2adb46fcebc82f3169cca15fb158f3ff20a367.webp)

### Data flow

![](images/fbce3353575ffd54ce470825734b15eb4bfdff7bce4360b3795b5e7c745b0591.webp)

### 7.12.6.4 Action test

Without disassembling any parts, use VDS to conduct action test on the suspected parts, and then judge whether the suspected parts function normally. Active test when troubleshooting can avoid unnecessary disassembly and improve diagnosis efficiency and accuracy.

1. When the vehicle is powered off, connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
2. Start the vehicle.
3. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
4. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New
Tang EV 2021” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → “ECU module” → “Driver s seat(BYD)”
5. Action test

a. Select "Action test" for performing active test.
