### Driver s seat calibration

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Driver s seat calibration process

![](images/7180c4bbd00610d6e19bfbbc5d86772a48031aebaac67405fc25b191e533de8f.webp)

T-4612A118

a. Select "VDS2000 Vehicle Diagnosis System".

![](images/f9a64a4a0d841049a11786774379b5e62806d8e790cfc99ba50f4c8926ca2ff4.webp)

b. Select Passenger car".

![](images/58c798b8d75e1889262333a95ebae7fa405f53d3c4636b81251b16b06b4ca45f.webp)

c. Select "EV series".

![](images/632351364c538552cfeca87e06943b47fcb23aac20fa4ff9b00e8537a2789258.webp)

d. Select "New Tang EV 2021".

![](images/68362575fa0b1305c67aa6409b7b7605b807bd76b80b57114a25365512fc68a1.webp)

e. Select "New Tang EV 2021 General".

![](images/02cd781be5ae075def235b4fb23985697814e87da534bab73bd59cc48c3f251e.webp)

f. Select "ECU module".

![](images/8291729ff720def85c7d4876ad91e2d162bab46ca21cef9a41e36bef23b945e6.webp)

g. Click the arrow shown in the figure.

![](images/d6cae5eb0a36345ebae21365e024170ba5fdb79834a59904b287a9efe7a98558.webp)

h. Select "Driver seat calibration".

![](images/1d349c0316583941f6df521b5bab0ce8bc366678df923e830b25a2debc368b2c.webp)

i. Click Read".

![](images/fcd0b690549947dfe5fa63c40031a626328d042e8ebf00e2f32d8f939dcadbba.webp)

j. Click the run button to perform calibration.

![](images/ef2a11927764888b6eda4e961bfad8d513b38c03bef663628095c2cefa2f165b.webp)

k. Calibration succeeded.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the driver seat assembly

![](images/2fca7c1e514b2b335cf2aef4b62995b4d8ddec45ce0e2dc24965961f7fb5f77e.webp)

a. Move the seat to the rear end, and remove the front left bracket sleeve of driver seat and the front right bracket sleeve of driver seat.

![](images/b02feac31e0d65222620695d4b08e073bf7810fb76ae20fb281927ac99c15134.webp)

b. Remove the 2 fixing bolts at the front end of the seat.

Torque: 45N•m

![](images/d35d3add60bdaa7ca9d2c18e3c3b78d89b736e1a5794dbdd4b2513968ea2b16c.webp)

c. Move the seat to the front end, and remove the rear left bracket sleeve of driver seat and the rear right bracket sleeve of driver seat.

![](images/07a0db40993e99510a7377dad68d365d0e414fcb8ac8c0c6e896050bb481abc6.webp)

d. Remove the 2 fixing bolts at the rear end of the seat.

Torque: 45N•m

e. Remove the engine trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Engine trimming panel assembly f. Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery), and wait for 90s. Refer to: Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery).

![](images/70e560db951cee18221ae6ce862911a06b72b268e37fea8b3da57eae66394613.webp)

g. Push the left outer shield 2 of driver seat horizontally backward.

![](images/4d7687570c89b7cd1f29bcb205f2fd2252f6cd7d9a30d37b7ac1a94110df96b3.webp)

h. Remove one fixing bolt at the lower end of the driver seat belt.

Torque: 44±4N•m

![](images/647a76e1654041d3ac23e2ed449b76a350fe4ca883239c10cfba01fbf328dd0f.webp)

i. Disconnect the connector A under the driver seat and the airbag connector B, and detach the wiring harness fixing clip.

j. Take out the driver seat assembly.

### i Caution:

The seat assembly is heavy, so special attention should be paid when taking it out to avoid scratching the interior trimmings or paint.

### Disassembly procedure

1. Disassemble the driver seat assembly.

![](images/f053ce48a970cdd9690be1eae70f7b337e271481a6dce1794dea11085a86ad85.webp)

a. Disengage 2 fixing pins and 3 hooks, and remove the driver seat front shield.

![](images/33d7a99ffdd018f50a6da4d215279bc1b98e2f93c9f3ce1999043bca797e4146.webp)

b. Pry out the driver seat six-way adjustment button and the driver seat two-way adjustment button.

![](images/fe4b47bb2ff5bda07a084b5fad68f2dd7790cffcb368d1573abba40e47e989d4.webp)

c. Remove the 2 fixing screws and push out the left outer shield of driver seat upwards.

### i Caution:

There is internal wiring harness connection, please do not remove it violently.

![](images/bed734f3d80c862aab12278b1e4f708eec368691bda845b597209505209534a9.webp)

d. Remove the 3 fixing screws A, disconnect the connector B, and remove the four-way lumbar support adjustment switch ①.
e. Disconnect the connector C of the driver power seat adjustment switch, remove the 2 fixing screws D, and take off the driver power seat adjustment switch ②.

![](images/7c2747c366585ccf9e26db0b2dce6333e1809c28c5bd4a681f1f31707b0bb2d4.webp)

f. Remove the 2 fixing screws and take off the left inner shield of driver seat.

![](images/21057e20f1a0e7c54a276f4e6589525024312e9ee606eb479ca64d4a1deef49d.webp)

g. Remove the right outer shield of driver seat.

![](images/70ccfa29467c2b88cbdadf4b2a5e822e809de99a729b81fd73332ce6653f674b.webp)

h. Disconnect the driver seat belt buckle connector.

![](images/cb4f9e3147420a529eaaf3a3eb915c7f2c08edad6c5c7a102525350fc506fd63.webp)

i. Remove the 2 fixing screws A and take off the right inner shield of driver seat.
j. Remove one fixing bolt B and take off the driver seat belt buckle. Torque: 44±4N•m

![](images/9627643a95031efd1c3c3dbe5fbd6270db8713d2929621e35b23e1ca2a2503be.webp)

k. Pry out the 2 fixing clips and remove the driver seat backplane assembly.

![](images/74f5dbbebb022d5593af4690e9a77632542ff578826877f115b8e4231f1ea64c.webp)

l. Disconnect the 5 connectors of the driver seat ECU assembly, pull the clip tongue on both sides outward, and remove the driver seat ECU assembly.

![](images/d26fab108a713af3537fd007da2d1938737c00bb0ad62f51409560cebac93f94.webp)

m. Insert a wire with a diameter less than 2mm into the unlocking holes at the same time, and pull out the front-row headrest assembly upwards.

![](images/7edb9f6fc743e89824406cdf664696ff016fbb97628cdd9b60247bb8ef88d087.webp)

n. Pry out the headrest sliding sleeve component and headrest sliding sleeve component for height adjustment.

### 0 Tip:

If it is not convenient to operate, raise part of the backrest cover first, clamp both sides of the headrest sliding sleeve with pliers and pull it out upside down.

### Assembly procedure

1. Assemble the driver seat assembly in an order reverse to its disassembly and pay attention to the following:

a. Ensure that connectors are installed in place.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the driver seat assembly in an order reverse to its removal.

a. Ensure that connectors are installed in place.
b. After installation, start the vehicle and check that the driver seat assembly should work properly.

### 7.12.8.2 Front passenger seat assembly

0 Tip:

The removal/installation and disassembly/assembly procedures of the driver and front passenger seat assemblies are basically the same. For removal and installation of the front passenger seat assembly, please refer to the driver seat assembly. Refer to: Driver seat assembly

### 7.12.8.3 Rear right seat assembly

0 Tip:

The removal/installation and disassembly/assembly procedures of the rear left /right seat assemblies are basically the same, please refer to the rear left seat assembly. Refer to: Rear left seat assembly
The following only lists the main differences between the rear right seat assembly and rear left seat assembly.

### Disassembly procedure

1. Disassemble the rear right seat assembly.

![](images/09367db09353d2952d0da1e251c5368f3123bbe114cfb9f5f481cc304a3079dd.webp)

a. Open the shoulder unlock handle and pry out the shoulder unlock handle cover.
b. Remove the 2 fixing screws and take off the shoulder unlock handle.

![](images/1d53f9b44fdd4ee2d57282513f89f8651c7b8ad010f22956d6892c340caf56ac.webp)

c. Disconnect the 2 cables of shoulder unlock handle, and remove the shoulder unlock handle.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the rear left seat assembly. a. Move the rear left seat to the foremost position.

![](images/a854114c5f5b109a2686af2ee56818197fc844d3e96c13cca4f7aa944bf71344.webp)

b. Disengage 7 clip tongues, and remove the rear left bracket sleeve of rear left seat.

![](images/44c6887ea1c94497b8b5dd452c320a359a9d24f3b737d9fa2ac25ab9e42d5ca9.webp)

c. Remove one rear left fixing bolt. Torque: 45N•m

![](images/3ab23193a248cae3f1b4e6a1479584ed2b05f5a1ed752840e510f202c3223aa3.webp)

d. Disengage 6 clip tongues, and remove the rear right bracket sleeve of rear left seat.

![](images/2304daa32c34730a25f05195f16284393b00d336269262c90f2219d76ac9385d.webp)

e. Remove the 3 rear right fixing bolts. Torque: 45N•m

f. Move the rear left seat to the rearmost position.

![](images/7d7f061be77f46983d9c1eec0fce64615d53c18e1658ba27eaf8d3e256035869.webp)

g. Disengage 2 clip tongues, and remove the front left bracket sleeve of rear left seat.

0 Tip: First pry the front end up, and then take out the bracket sleeve horizontally forward.

![](images/e1cfd647e62e2dee3f0f258498b35859def6bb3561d9bc04af404d016eedca5e.webp)

h. Remove one front left fixing bolt. Torque: 45N•m

![](images/1bad3a99df4250703c94b909a820c3f9e83531edfaaf57a98432c1fd2c23a2ac.webp)

i. Disengage 3 clip tongues, and remove the front right bracket sleeve of rear left seat.

### 0 Tip:

First pry the front end up, and then take out the bracket sleeve horizontally forward.

![](images/ad9fe1f60857b10e345b36fedc0e3d0b6f5b92477423a4ed782cb8819786f344.webp)

j. Remove one front right fixing bolt. Torque: 45N•m

![](images/40f706da7d0a571396a63ba5a777a2cb88a788f230f9e57095aadc020078b48f.webp)

k. Disconnect the rear left seat assembly connector, and disengage 2 wiring harness clips.

l. Fold and remove the rear left seat assembly.

i Caution: The seat assembly is heavy, so special attention should be paid when taking it out to avoid scratching the interior trimmings or paint.

### Disassembly procedure

1. Disassemble the rear left seat assembly.

![](images/720095a1c4be9ae5e2aaba1085a00e62d74ccac17a1dc5a3851b729f5a2a8a1a.webp)

a. Pry out the rear left seat angle adjusting handle cover ①. b. Pull out the rear left seat angle adjusting handle c. Remove one fixing screw, pry out one fixing tongue, and move forward to remove the left outer shield of rear left seat.

![](images/08e920491cbb765fc50169c02f5a4c58a66945e26af0995b5b7a97e77ebfc8b8.webp)

![](images/0426ba925fc55bc7f64ccf352a5a410bbf3a93ae7fee6f5b1a1e66961bc5da8f.webp)

d. Remove the left inner shield of rear left seat.

![](images/78460fcf837efa231cb20548c0c03deac1051e707ca65825413e29ffd7c3e6e2.webp)

e. Disconnect the seat belt buckle connector and disengage the hook.

![](images/ab5dd31f1a468efc63f49b463918e9ffa72b45ebe5111b3fb97ec6070347de43.webp)

f. Remove one fixing screw of the right inner shield.

![](images/f2c8d8cf9300b5d310228a5adf30ce5305bb0da1b11e0bdb8b84101729ed4c35.webp)

g. Remove one fixing screw A of the right outer shield.
h. Remove one fixing bolt B of the middle seat belt buckle in the middle row. Torque: 44±4N•m
i. Remove the middle seat belt buckle ② in the middle row and the right outer shield ① of the rear left seat.

![](images/212724aa23de12c88316259628a9d5f0dca8eda1862f50a5ed9cd1c2ad9f5815.webp)

j. Remove the right inner shield ① of the rear left seat.

![](images/bbaaba38d0724850729a195b125eae4f58535793d3c568ee9020c3e58bf51a6f.webp)

k. Disconnect the left seat belt buckle connector in the middle row.

![](images/3b071e68c670e21f8dcda7e84c3a4b7fc551c1a8b075c3ff87d2f64a3a00a13b.webp)

l. Remove one fixing bolt of the left seat belt buckle in the middle row, and remove the left seat belt buckle in the middle row.

### 0 Tip:

If the line of sight is blocked, ensure that the sockets and bolts are installed in place during removal and installation, and then tighten them with force to avoid damaging the thread teeth.

![](images/2e9c4d367e533a250f3491c1e3fe8a52158f60392e4cb542524c9b8784fd2761.webp)

m. Pry out 2 metal clips and remove the central armrest inner cover plate.

![](images/544776e5a460eb12da14caebd22e4dafed62377ed17d656d6b60207d521d9c23.webp)

n. Remove the 2 fixing bolts of central armrest and remove the central armrest assembly.

![](images/ed42ec66849e1fcfa2dabf6d8ddc0ecda4bd41b5631655c6b4cd282407fc2fd9.webp)

o. Press the headrest unlocking button and pull out the headrest.

![](images/3023f6687427039043a87cd1f8565b99dc358a11ea5d1d27a4f0b7db39ca85a6.webp)

p. Pry out the seat headrest sliding sleeve ① and headrest sliding sleeve ② for height adjustment.

### 0 Tip:

If it is not convenient to operate, raise part of the backrest cover first, and remove it from the inside.

![](images/37a2f6334869cc498cbcb5a08c5a9cf67268aa64025eb8a5122a56aad61c1788.webp)

q. Pry out and remove the child safety seat buckle box.

![](images/a1625a67e28ea91f456a5da28edff8883cc1d822467683449dd1bddd53311b4b.webp)

r. Pry out and remove the seat belt outlet cover.

![](images/da7265d762239b7e1be84eb9fcb0b7462714219763e004efe519421c16d05e49.webp)

s. Remove the 2 fixing screws and take off the seat belt outlet cover base.

![](images/8f61f4962c545f0d6dda69be03f57a8c1f61fa0d12389e2ecd1673401cefb307.webp)

t. Disconnect each end of the rear left seat slide rail unlocking cable and remove the rear left seat slide rail unlocking cable ②.
u. Disconnect the connectors of the seat wiring harness and remove the rear left seat wiring harness ①.

v. Remove the C-shaped nails from the cover to take off the seat backrest cover and sponge foam.

### Assembly procedure

1. Assemble the rear left seat assembly in an order reverse to its disassembly and pay attention to the following: a. Ensure that connectors and cables are installed in place.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the rear left seat assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

a. Ensure that connectors are installed in place.
b. After installation, start the vehicle and check that the seat assembly should work properly.

### 7.12.8.5 Backrest assembly of the third row seats

0 Tip:

This manual takes the removal and installation of the left backrest assembly of the third row seats as an example. For the removal and installation of the right backrest assembly of the third row seats, please refer to the left side.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the seat cushion assembly of the third row seats. Refer to: Seat cushion assembly of the third row seats
2. Remove the left backrest assembly of the third row seats.

![](images/9ac00c9539863e0e46a6cb3d373905062eb7457dae8df0938e8cd02709c33d17.webp)

a. Remove the 2 fixing nuts A and 2 fixing bolts B at the front end of backrest. Torque of bolt B: 45N•m

![](images/455d486ed87120cb24805822877c6ca280f93c71c98e4522895feb9dbdcf16bc.webp)

b. Remove the 2 fixing bolts on the back of the backrest, and take off the left backrest assembly of the third row seats. Torque: 45N•m

### Disassembly procedure

1. Disassemble the left backrest assembly of the third row seats.

![](images/170b9f8669a74f382dcb938fdba879196e9357df6eeda25c470ca7425297894c.webp)

a. Press the seat unlocking button to remove the seat headrest.

![](images/f55db82df43534046c3147ff87ad332386a427333fae74a390c522cd3b00c3cb.webp)

b. Remove one fixing screw, and take off the rear unlocking handle shield.

### 0 Tip:

Remove the unlocking handle from the fracture.

![](images/6c2ae2d8438f9c6b08059f45406828145e8753997fc68baddcef05cd8624ff60.webp)

c. Remove the 2 fixing screws A, disconnect the seat lay-down cable, and remove the left outer shield ① of the left seat in the third row.

0 Tip: Remove the left inner shield of the third row seats as required.

d. Remove the 2 fixing screws B, and remove the right outer shield ② of the left seat in the third row.

0 Tip:

Remove the right inner shield of the third row seats as required.

![](images/5ab972d429c787d598116a45f6fad48186b840f06389fa4a72cd60be600ce042.webp)

e. Pry out the 2 fixing clips and remove the backrest unlocking cover of the third row seats.

![](images/71ea724fa8ec8c7fcb79ac6f4c79f465a3f25b57a87bfbe9f779bfc56394690d.webp)

f. Disengage the edge of the seat mask and open the mask and sponge.

![](images/306e4563e6c3728437acb41ea71a7008df57a69daeb087d82fb2c22dce51dcc1.webp)

h. Remove the seat mask and sponge.

g. Press and push out the headrest sliding sleeve from the inside of the seat.

![](images/012b76d252486321a9b653f701727fc11c7db3d927ad9f98f91bb67dd7fdb671.webp)

i. Remove the 4 fixing screws and take off the unlocking handle cover.

![](images/fd72c45dae2072ae43f16824eeedf0a4e168fb90a5c37f756a08d0bd2695af60.webp)

j. Disengage the unlocking handle, and remove the rear unlocking handle assembly ① of the third row seats.
k. Disengage both ends of the unlocking cable and remove the unlocking cable ② of the third row seats..

### Assembly procedure

1. Assemble the left backrest assembly of the third row seats in an order reverse to its disassembly.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the seat cushion assembly of the third row seats.

![](images/6fa9de9111745cdd6d68211969ce2268e2d1710691e0d8f0075a0947caf35b32.webp)

a. Take off the middle seat belt buckle and remove one fixing nut.

![](images/c5d7c6ee86ee3f1a86fd324a159a20802458a4081c28ca8d8ff286a254fad167.webp)

b. Pull up the front end of the seat cushion with force and disengage the 2 rear seat cushion retaining bases.

![](images/8295acca2e4d2943219961c0763b70ceb3c5a1bd2f0963adc65165bb96a87eac.webp)

c. Disconnect the 2 connectors of occupant detection sensor.

d. Remove the seat cushion assembly of third row seats.
e. Replace the rear seat cushion retaining base assembly as required.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the seat cushion assembly of the third row seats in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following: a. Ensure that connectors are installed in place.

b. After installation, start the vehicle and check that the occupant detection sensor in the third row should work properly.

### 7.13.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. The interior trimming skid plate should be used for assisting in removal. If there is no skid plate, a screwdriver or equivalent can be used instead, but it should be wrapped.

2. Be careful to remove the exterior trimmings with clips to avoid damage to the clip or parts.

3. Do not pry the clip tongue and claw with excessive force to avoid damage.

4. Since most trimmings are fixed by clips, it is necessary to ensure that all clips are pried out before removing trimmings.

5. Do not remove the trimmings by force to avoid damage.

6. Check and replace all damaged clips.

7. The trimming part should be placed in a clean and flat position to avoid rubbing its surface.

8. Components containing clip tongues should be installed in place to avoid falling off after installation and affecting the trimming effect.

9. Be sure to check whether the fixing clips of parts are missing when installing parts, and add fixing clips if missing.

### 7.14.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. Important precautions for seat belt system

i Caution:
• Beware of collision of retractor when removing and installing the seat belt assembly. If the seat belt pre-tensioner (retractor) has dropped down from a height of 900mm and above, it must be replaced. After installation, check that the retractor should be in normal condition. The seat belt should be replaced immediately if it is damaged, unwired or the buckle is not working properly. If there has been a crash and the seat belt bears a certain impact, even if no damage is found, it should be replaced immediately. Do not insert foreign objects into the buckle of the seat belt, and do not modify or remove the seat belt. When the seat belt is dirty, clean it with neutral detergent instead of corrosive agent, dye or dry cleaning agent; otherwise it will seriously affect the strength of the seat belt. Keep the seat belt dry and clean. If the seat belt is damaged, cracked or deformed due to chemical action or sunlight, be sure to replace it. If the metal connecting parts of the seat belt are bent, deformed or rusted, be sure to replace the seat belt. Performance requirements of retractor: It should be freely retracted at the installation angle, and can be automatically retracted. Performance requirements of buckle: There must be a clear feeling of being in place during the locking tongue insertion and buckle opening. The buckle must not be opened by itself, and the assembly must not fail. Do not attempt to repair the retractor. Replace the non-functioning assembly with a new one.

### 2. Important precautions for pre-tensioned seat belt

！ Warning:

For vehicle equipped with seat belt pretensioner, the maintenance of SRS components or lines and repair of SRS peripheral components or lines shall be undertaken by BYD authorised dealers or repair outlets.

### A Caution:

The seat belt pretensioner belongs to SRS, so many repair procedures should follow the precautions of SRS.
Before maintenance operation, be sure to disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) and wait for 90s.
If parts and components of SRS may be impacted during maintenance, remove them first. Be sure to remove connectors of the (driver's and front passenger's) airbag (gas generator) and the seat belt pretensioner respectively before performing electric welding. When painting around the SRS and its relevant parts, be sure to prevent the conductor or connector from being exposed to paint mist.
Never allow parts and components of SRS be directly exposed to high temperature enviroment (in case of drying or baking of the vehicle after painting) or be close to flame. If the pretightening function of seat belt is activated, be sure to replace the seat belt.

### 1. Function

a. Automobile seat belt is a safety device for restraining occupants in collision, avoiding secondary collision between occupants and steering wheel or dashboard, or avoiding occupants being thrown out of the car.
b. The vehicle, the driver and passengers all have kinetic energy when the vehicle is in motion. The strength of this kinetic energy is dependent on the vehicle's speed, kerb weight of the vehicle and all occupants inside it. The greater the speed and combined mass, the stronger the energy released in a crash.
c. As a collision occurs, occupants who do not have their seat belts fastened continue to move forward at their speed before the collision due to inertia. Meanwhile, the vehicle does not move along with the occupants. This may cause serious injuries to occupants inside the vehicle.
d. In a vehicular collision where occupants have their seat belts fastened, the seat belt can restrain occupants and keep them in a proper position, reducing their forward inertia and preventing them from being thrown out. In addition, the seat belt offers occupants the best protection along with the airbag, thus reducing injuries from the collision impact as much as possible.
e. The front-row and middle-row seat belts are equipped with pretensioner devices. The pretensioner is mixed into the retractor and controlled by SRS electronic control unit. It is a part of the SRS component. When the impact force on the front of the vehicle exceeds the specified value, the pretensioner and the airbag will be triggered at the same time.
f. If the vehicle suffers a severe frontal collision and the condition to trigger the pretensioner is met, the pretensioner retracts part of the seat belt rapidly and locks it up to enhance the protection for passengers. The pretensioner limits the restraining force applied to passengers to a certain range, avoiding injury to passengers due to excessive restraining force.

### 2. Composition

a. Main structures of automobile seat belt: webbing, retractor, buckle, locking tongue, etc.
b. Seat belts for front seats and middle seats are equipped with pre-tensioner.

### 7.14.7.2 DTC reading and clearing

Use VDS to read and clear the vehicle fault codes, and determine the current DTC to help maintenance personnel to test quickly.

1. The vehicle is powered off.
2. Connect VDS to the diagnostic interface.
3. Start the vehicle.
4. Turn on VDS and establish communication with the vehicle.
5. Select “VDS2000 vehicle diagnosis system” → “Passenger car” → “EV series” → “New
Tang EV 2021 ” → “New Tang EV 2021 General” → ECU module” →Airbag(New)(BYD)”

6. Read and clear the DTC.

![](images/1b427a4c4451d3fe862154458bec930b3f83b96cd1f01f793f0dad769345e557.webp)

a. Select “Fault detection” to read DTC.
b. Select “Clear fault” to clear DTC.

### 1. Basic inspection

a. Check if the seat belt reminder, seat belt, buckle, tongue, retractor and fixing devices are working normally.
b. Check if the seat belt system is loose or damaged, and there are any objects that may affect its normal operation.
c. If the seat belt is cracked or worn, replace it immediately.
d. Keep the seat belt clean and dry.

### 2. Check the seat belt reminder

a. When the vehicle is powered on, check all seats one by one. When there is an occupant in this seat and the seat belt is not fastened, the seat belt reminder should be on. b. When the occupant wears the seat belt, the seat belt reminder should go out. c. If a seat does not meet the above conditions, the seat gravity sensor or seat belt switch may be damaged. Check and replace the corresponding parts.

### 7.14.9.1 Front seat belt assembly

0 Tip:

This manual takes the removal and installation of the front left seat belt assembly as an example. For the removal and installation of the front right seat belt assembly, please refer to the left side.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the engine trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Engine trimming panel assembly
2. Disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery). Refer to: Disconnect the
cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery)
3. Remove the lower left shield assembly of dashboard. Refer to: Lower left shield assembly of
dashboard
4. Remove the front left door sill shield assembly. Refer to: Front door sill shield assembly
5. Remove the rear left door sill shield assembly. Refer to: Rear door sill shield assembly
6. Remove the left B-pillar lower shield assembly. Refer to: B-pillar lower shield assembly
7. Remove the left B-pillar upper shield assembly. Refer to: B-pillar upper shield assembly
8. Remove the front left seat belt assembly

![](images/78b12fd42db08243ec07e056a89e1754c7e7c6c2f6529f144b1684114ecf30e1.webp)

a. Remove one fixing nut on the upper end. Torque: 44N•m

### 0 Tip:

One fixing bolt at the lower end of the seat belt assembly was removed when removing the B-pillar shield.

![](images/0a07a21658df805b2f5f87a7a26ed136c30b84a3ef19b0e33d0fb384f8ed3975.webp)

b. Remove the 2 fixing bolts and take off the seat belt guide bracket. Torque: 12N•m

![](images/ab99d84941b7bc3a2c791f3efd294a0e5be6a644fd6e3f4f3da51aac2af8f5d4.webp)

c. Disconnect the front left seat belt connector A, remove the fixing bolt B and the fixing bolt C, and remove the front left seat belt assembly. Torque of bolt B: 44N•m Torque of bolt C: 12N•m

### Installation procedures

1. Install the front left seat belt assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

a. The connector should be installed in place.
b. After installation, pull the seat belt quickly, which should be effectively locked.

### 7.15.3.1 Warnings and precautions

1. Warnings for removal and installation of windscreen

A Warning: When removing the windscreen, be sure to wear protective gloves and goggles to avoid hurting skin or eyes.
i Caution: Glue coating should be uniform and continuous, and the cross section of glue coating is preferably trapezoidal or triangular. Glue should be applied continuously, as far as possible along the middle position of the frame to prevent excessive glue spillage.

### i Caution:

Be sure to move glass with care and place it firmly to prevent damage to the glass during operation. If a piece of glass is cracked but still intact, the protective tape should be attached to the glass in a cross shape to avoid further damage to the glass or personal injury.

### 7.15.4.1 Exploded view of components

Glass and seals

![](images/f1b875732e19305617319fd681689d0ddb96daa0844346541d9f60796a4dc941.webp)

![](images/6481e5f7039e6dcf7aef6db837bfd538893502ccac8fe0f32e1eefbe4339b0ad.webp)

![](images/20c50873d75c39b2c67ff69b6504307d0d1eb661f0f98d38e5f92da78d724414.webp)

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the upper shield assembly of pillar A on the left and right sides. Refer to: Upper shield assembly of pillar A

2. Remove the vehicle data recorder camera. Refer to: Vehicle data recorder camera
3. Remove the four-in-one sensor. Refer to: Four-in-one sensor

4. Remove the multi-function video controller assembly. Refer to: Multi-function video controller assembly

5. Remove the rear view mirror assembly. Refer to: Rear view mirror assembly

6. Remove the engine trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Engine trimming panel assembly

7. Remove the front left/right compartment trimming panel assembly. Refer to: Front compartment trimming panel assembly

8. Remove the left and right wiper arm and blade assemblies of front wiper. Refer to: Wiper arm and blade assemblies of front wiper

9. Remove the ventilation cover assembly. Refer to: Ventilation cover assembly
10.Perform protection operations.

a. Cover the area around the A/C vent with a thin film to prevent the scattered broken glass from falling into the vent port and causing hidden dangers.

A Warning: If the broken glass falls into the A/C vent, the A/C assembly will be damaged or the glass is blown into the cab when turning on the A/C, and personal injury may be caused. b. Stick protective tape on the body and dashboard around the front windscreen assembly to prevent damage to the vehicle during removal.

11.Remove the front windscreen assembly a. Make a hole at the corner of windscreen inside the vehicle with an awl, pass the wire saw through it, and fix both ends of the wire saw on the handle.

![](images/68281b951aae295d1d46f009aa545c73fff9b950e6a0d3cf60e01d9049e311d9.webp)

Caution: Take care not to damage the paint.

![](images/ef8019eea19b74312431891774001126ebd476ba5988ec79f16795f5f2dd38a9.webp)

b. Pull the wire saw around the front windscreen assembly to cut the surrounding glass sealant.

### i Caution:

Two persons are required to perform this step.
Note that there are 2 windscreen studs at the position of arrow A in the figure, which should be avoided when cutting.
Ensure that the protective tape ① is stuck in place to effectively protect the surface of vehicle body.
When cutting the front windscreen assembly, be careful not to damage the paint or interior and exterior trimmings.

![](images/684d55a768ad815964ff5b2724ef7b3118a2bf1aa29d8708a29fcb7bdc5f4e4b.webp)

c. Cut the surrounding glass sealant by referring to the arrow direction in the figure.

![](images/1b2ae6cea0f5a7d419c467a041636f40a6c7fd0a2b0a9450b757c1d4cbebf5b1.webp)

d. Remove the front windscreen assembly with a glass suction tray.

A Warning: Check that the suction tray should be installed firmly to avoid damage to components or personal injury caused by dropping halfway.
i Caution: Two persons are required to perform this step. Avoid damaging the vehicle during removal and installation.

![](images/bbc346d95bb365454f305e17d16edf05710a4c3a24997c5f9f6637811b6a50ce.webp)

e. Remove the residual glass sealant ① on the mounting surface of the vehicle body with a scraper, so that the thickness of each part is about 2mm.

### i Caution:

Be careful not to damage the body surface. Do not scrape the vehicle body paintwork. Paintwork damage will affect the bonding effect.

### 0 Tip:

Leave about 2mm glass adhesive on the vehicle body for better installation of front windscreen assembly.

f. Clean debris inside the vehicle and the body surface.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the front windscreen assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

![](images/bb8bef97984eb76c5d2b2f6d9430cb440367d39e03c7d0d482ea8d76ae4d66d0.webp)

a. Place the front windscreen assembly in the installation position with a glass suction tray, note that the 2 windscreen studs A of the glass assembly is aligned with the mounting holes on the vehicle body during installation, and check that the glass should be in smooth contact with the mounting surface.

### 0 Tip:

![](images/08fad77faef9bd4a3a501d31282b34214b67388030f35a6b39cce079103cde23.webp)

Check and confirm that the entire contact surface of the front windscreen assembly edge is smooth enough, and trim it again if not.
b. After inspection, remove the front windscreen assembly.
c. Clean the bonding surface of vehicle body with glass detergent (or alcohol) and dry it for 10min. After cleaning, do not contact with grease or water.
d. Apply primer evenly to the glass bonding surface and the body bonding surface with a brush, with a width of about 15mm. ①: Glass cleaning agent ②: Glass/paint primer

![](images/7b9795c3a4f049160a7e44ac9fc197969ef64f968f6dcf23a6a9f9f4050195e6.webp)

e. As shown in the figure, apply equal cross-section glass adhesive evenly to the installation position of the vehicle body.

①: Glass sealant
②: Vehicle body

### i Caution:

Do not apply glass adhesive to the glass; otherwise it is not easy to find the installation position during installation.

f. Place the front windscreen assembly with a glass suction tray, align the mounting holes of locating pin, and then press in gently along the edge.

### i Caution:

Slightly adjust the left and right positions of the glass to make it as symmetrical as possible.
Slightly pat the glass surface and the area around the sealing rubber strip to make the glass be appressed against the vehicle body.
Complete gluing and installation within 10 minutes to ensure that the sealant has enough adhesive force.

g. Gently press the surface of the front windscreen assembly to ensure that it is firmly installed on the vehicle body.

h. Secure the front windscreen assembly with protective tape until the glass sealant hardens.

### 0 Tip:

Please follow the instructions of the glass sealant manufacturer or the corresponding instructions for the minimum waiting time before driving the vehicle. Install other accessories in the rear view mirror area after the sealant is cured.
• Do not use compressed air for drying.
• Do not use the equipment such as ultraviolet bulbs for drying. When suddenly closing the door leads to a closed space in the car, there is prone to instant high pressure in the car, so try not to suddenly close the door before the glass sealant dries to prevent the glass from loosening or falling off.

i. Take out the covering film and protective tape from the vehicle.

2. Check for water leakage (rainfall test).

![](images/009bb0aa1048c4fcb9eeeff5aad037afcfe8fc90b893b68714387a3da7ea550c.webp)

a. After the sealant is hardened, sprinkle water from the outside of the vehicle (10min), check and confirm whether there is water leakage. If so, clean the water mark and replenish the glass sealant in time.

### Removal procedures

1. Remove the upper shield assembly of boot lid. Refer to: Upper shield assembly of boot lid
2. Remove the lower shield assembly of boot lid. Refer to: Lower shield assembly of boot lid
3. Remove spoiler body assembly. Refer to: Spoiler body assembly
4. Remove the rear wiper arm and blade assembly. Refer to: Rear wiper arm and blade assembly
5. Remove the middle taillight. Refer to: Middle taillight
6. Perform protection operations. a. Stick protective tape on the body around the boot lid glass assembly to prevent damage to the vehicle during removal.

7. Remove the boot lid glass assembly.

![](images/830fd594d4415bfa5c7a59e95480f3d745850d84a0ebbe6637a4b96edda90928.webp)

a. Disconnect connectors on both sides.

![](images/f09e491d25371b1cc80e9fb00420a64cd7b6a15c9d7203fc5de375c294aa02fc.webp)

b. Make a hole at the corner of boot lid glass inside the vehicle with an awl, pass the wire saw through it, and fix both ends of the wire saw on the handle.

i Caution: Take care not to damage the paint.

![](images/fadb86a909d7a78b34c78b999a7ce87ada58978764a7841e816808614829490f.webp)

c. Pull the wire saw around the boot lid glass assembly to cut the surrounding glass sealant.

### i Caution:

Two persons are required to perform this step.
Note that there are 4 windscreen studs at the position of arrow A in the figure, which should be avoided when cutting.
Ensure that the protective tape ① is stuck in place to effectively protect the surface of vehicle body.
When cutting the boot lid glass assembly, be careful not to damage the paint.

![](images/a1260ba12be5b80a118e2bc45afac77381ddc3452801272394e0bc829ccbc77c.webp)

d. Remove the boot lid glass assembly with a glass suction tray.

！ Warning: Check that the suction tray should be installed firmly to avoid damage to components or personal injury caused by dropping halfway.

### i Caution:

Two persons are required to perform this step.
Avoid damaging the vehicle during removal and installation.

![](images/4fc5e74a060e2f54f4970e483cdf9447caa72acfaa94040a7131fad9d11af3aa.webp)

e. Remove the residual glass sealant ① on the mounting surface of the vehicle body with a scraper, so that the thickness of each part is about 1\~2mm.

### i Caution:

Be careful not to damage the body surface. Do not scrape the vehicle body paintwork. Paintwork damage will affect the bonding effect.

### 0 Tip:

Leave about 1\~2mm glass adhesive on the vehicle body for better installation of the boot lid glass assembly.

f. Clean debris inside the vehicle and the body surface.

### Installation procedures

1. Install the trunk lid glass assembly in an order reverse to its removal and pay attention to the following:

![](images/71f7eb455b9a0df2f69ce9cb68756dd2d5d09ceea9ec446fd86830e150c432d8.webp)

a. Place the boot lid glass assembly in the installation position with a glass suction tray, note that the 4 windscreen studs A of the glass assembly is aligned with the mounting holes on the vehicle body during installation, and check that the glass should be in smooth contact with the mounting surface.

### 0 Tip:

![](images/ac80fc04f69ec7075411eb7d13feb3951a0644b5bc7d108d28097118b6519315.webp)

Check and confirm that the entire contact surface of the boot lid glass assembly edge is smooth enough, and trim it again if not.
b. After inspection, remove the boot lid glass assembly.
c. Clean the bonding surface of vehicle body with glass detergent (or alcohol) and dry it for 10min. After cleaning, do not contact with grease or water.
d. Apply primer evenly to the glass bonding surface and the body bonding surface with a brush, with a width of about 15mm. ①: Glass cleaning agent ②: Glass/paint primer

e. As shown in the figure, apply equal cross-section glass adhesive evenly to the installation position of the vehicle body.

①: Glass sealant
②: Vehicle body

### i Caution:

Do not apply glass adhesive to the glass; otherwise it is not easy to find the installation position during installation.

f. Place the boot lid glass assembly with a glass suction tray, align the mounting holes of locating pin, and then press in gently along the edge.

i Caution: Slightly adjust the left and right positions of the glass to make it as symmetrical as possible. Slightly pat the glass surface and the area around the sealing rubber strip to make the glass be appressed against the vehicle body. Complete gluing and installation within 10 minutes to ensure that the sealant has enough adhesive force.

g. Gently press the surface of the boot lid glass assembly to ensure that it is firmly installed on the vehicle body.

h. Secure the boot lid glass assembly with protective tape until the glass sealant hardens.

### 0 Tip:

Please follow the instructions of the glass sealant manufacturer or the corresponding instructions for the minimum waiting time before driving the vehicle.
Do not use compressed air for drying.
Do not use the equipment such as ultraviolet bulbs for drying.
When suddenly closing the door leads to a closed space in the car, there is prone to instant high pressure in the car, so try not to suddenly close the door before the glass sealant dries to prevent the glass from loosening or falling off.

i. Remove the protective tape.

2. Check for water leakage (rainfall test).

![](images/08d1559163d9feec1c2ea9bba420b6c16b5fa09e1ee7a62625d767621ae87428.webp)

a. After the sealant is hardened, sprinkle water from the outside of the vehicle (10min), check and confirm whether there is water leakage. If so, clean the water mark and replenish the glass sealant in time.

### 8.1 Plastic panel information and maintenance

8.1.1 Description and operation  2846

8.1.1.1 Warnings and precautions 2846

8.1.1.2 Sandpaper classification.. 2847

### 8.1.2 Maintenance operation guidance 2848

8.1.2.1 Classification of plastic parts . ： 2848

8.1.2.2 Characteristics of plastic materials 2849

8.1.2.3 Maintenance for pits of thermosetting plastics. 2851

8.1.2.4 Maintenance for scratches of thermosetting plastics 2852

8.1.2.5 Maintenance for cracks of thermosetting plastics. 2853

8.1.2.7 Plastic bonding 2856

### i Caution:

Apply protective cream to exposed skin to prevent skin irritation.
Wear rubber gloves during operation.
Wear the safety goggles when using the air compressor and sander.
Wear a dust mask and safety goggles when grinding or sanding.
Immediately remove any mixture that comes into contact with the skin because the mixture will cure very quickly.
Wash the skin with cold water to reduce the slight irritation caused by the resin particles. Use the maintenance materials in a well-ventilated environment because the smoke and dust particles generated by the maintenance materials are toxic.
After use, close all containers of maintenance materials. Dust or moisture can contaminate the maintenance materials and reduce the maintenance effect.

### 8.1.1.2 Sandpaper classification

1. Sandpaper classification

![](images/b583bd786d3699e06ba85b7cbf7d2de2a226111bd6f79b0eee2b9c636d317acb.webp)

0 Tip: According to the grinding requirements, select the appropriate sandpaper type.

### 8.1.2.1 Classification of plastic parts

1. It is very important to know the material characteristics of plastic parts during maintenance. Plastic parts can be roughly divided into thermoplastic parts and thermosetting plastic parts according to different materials. Thermoplastics and thermosetting plastics can be either hard plastics or soft plastics.

2. Thermoplastic parts:

a. Thermoplastics refers to those that can be heated and softened repeatedly to flow and cooled and hardened within a specific temperature range. This process is reversible and can be repeated, such as polyethylene and polytetrafluoroethylene. Therefore, thermoplastic parts can be repeatedly cured and molded by heating and melting, so the waste materials of thermoplastics can usually be recycled.
b. Thermoplastic parts are best repaired by welding machine filled with hot iron plastic materials, but usually replaced.
c. At present, the covering parts of interior and exterior trimming surfaces are mainly made of modified PP, ABS, PC +ABS and PVC (artificial leather material), all of which are thermoplastics and its modified material thermoplastics; POM, PA and HDPE materials are also used for covering parts of interior and exterior trimming non-surfaces.

### 3. Thermosetting plastic parts:

a. Thermosetting plastics refer to those that can be cured under heat or other conditions or have insoluble (infusible) properties, such as phenolic plastics and epoxy plastics. Thermosetting plastics can soften and flow when heated for the first time, and become hard (curing) by chemical reaction when heated to a certain temperature. This change is irreversible, and they can no longer soften and flow when heated again. Thermosetting plastic parts are molded and processed by virtue of this feature, The plasticizing flow during the first heating is used to fill the cavity under pressure, and then cure into a product of a certain shape and size.
b. Compared with thermoplastic parts, thermosetting plastic parts are harder and more brittle, and their state is not easy to change when heated. If heating is continued, thermosetting plastic parts will be damaged when the temperature exceeds the critical point.
c. Thermosetting plastics are mainly used as structural parts in electronic appliances and safety parts, and are used for heat insulation, wear resistance, insulation and high voltage resistance. Thermosetting plastics are rarely used in interior and exterior trimmings, and only the ash pan will use phenolic plastics.
d. Epoxy resin or other harder two-component maintenance materials can be used for maintenance of thermosetting plastics.

### 0 Tip:

Heat-resistance temperature refers to the temperature that may cause thermal deformation of components during operation.
Immersion refers to soaking in liquid.

### 8.1.2.3 Maintenance for pits of thermosetting plastics

1. Clean and dry the parts to be repaired.

2. Heat the pit with a hot air blower until it can be flattened with a suitable tool.
3. Grind the pit area with sandpaper or emery paper.
4. Clean the maintenance parts with cleaning agent and wait for about 5min to dry.
5. Apply a thin layer of adhesive and wait for about 10min to dry.
6. Fill the uneven surface with adhesive and smooth it with a spatula.
7. Accelerate the curing process with an infrared lamp, adjust the temperature to 60℃ \~70℃
(140℉\~158℉), and heat for about 15min.
8. Grind the pits with sandpaper.
9. Remove dust and debris.
10.Apply a thin layer of adhesive and wait for about 10min to dry.
11.Restore the top coat according to the top coat repair procedure of plastic parts surface.

### 8.1.2.4 Maintenance for scratches of thermosetting plastics

1. Clean and dry the parts to be repaired.

2. Remove protruding materials with sandpaper.
3. Then clean the maintenance parts with cleaning agent and dry them for 5min.
4. Apply a layer of adhesive and dry it for 10min.
5. Fill the uneven surface with adhesive and smooth it with a spatula.
6. Accelerate the curing process with an infrared lamp, adjust the temperature to 60℃ \~70℃
(140℉\~158℉), and heat for 15min.
7. Grind the recessed area with sandpaper.
8. Remove dust/debris.
9. Apply a thin layer of adhesive and dry it for 10min.
10.Restore the top coat according to the top coat repair procedure of plastic parts surface.

### 0 Tip:

Applicable to maintenance operations with a crack length less than 100mm.

1. Clean and dry the parts to be repaired.

2. Cut the end of the crack for 5mm, and grind the crack into a "V” shape to eliminate the internal stress and projection part.

3. Clean the maintenance parts with cleaning agent and dry them for 5min.

4. Apply a layer of adhesive and dry it for 10min.

5. First stick the reinforcing tape to the back of the maintainable part with adhesive, and overlap with the damaged parts by 20mm at least.

6. Accelerate the curing process with an infrared lamp, adjust the temperature to 60℃ \~70℃ (140℉\~158℉), and heat for 15min.

Fill the polished crack front with adhesive and smooth it with a spatula.

8. Accelerate the curing process of crack front with an infrared lamp.

9. Grind the recessed area with sandpaper.

10.Apply a thin layer of adhesive and dry it for 10min.

11.Remove dust/debris.

12.Apply a layer of adhesive and dry it for 10min.

13.Restore the top coat according to the top coat repair procedure of plastic parts surface.

### 1. Cut the crack into V-shaped section and prepare for welding

a. Cut into V-shaped welds by using a scraper, with an opening angle of 60°\~70°. b. Drill holes with a 3mm drill bit at the end of cracks to prevent cracks from extending. If the weld edge is uneven, repair the starting position of cracks with a tong before welding, and then drill holes at the end of cracks.

2. Set the welding temperature (200℃ \~700℃) according to the specified value of the manufacturer. The thickness of plastic materials and welding rods determines the welding temperature a. Preheat the welding equipment for 3\~4min to make it reach the pre-selected welding temperature. b. Cut the front end of the welding rod into an inclined plane so as to fill it gradually from the starting position of the crack weld.

3. Welding

![](images/8f536e0cd102462b5750f3f407d5d10ad51039aaaa6626f19af3be5426eec150.webp)

a. Push the plastic welding rod with the front end cut into an inclined plane into the preheating chamber of the heated quick welding nozzle until the tip of the welding rod is exposed from the lower part. When the welding rod and parts to be welded are in plastic state, the welding operation can be started. There must be a stable welding speed and operating pressure when welding plastics.
b. The lower end of the quick welding nozzle must move parallel to the repair surface. The plastic welding torch must move in parallel and at a constant speed.
c. Keep the welding rod perpendicular to the weld when moving the plastic welding torch.

![](images/56f7dc927e0a21cc6642a1ee06274200bd0a576b57a71f9f1ff6cda1e8dfff82.webp)

4. Check the welded joint a. If only a small or smooth bulge is formed along the weld edge during welding, it means that the welding effect is ideal. It is very important for welding the weld of grooves.

![](images/08ebfb77dabf2d8c81c498f76040b2485522ea70cedb2bde2d9c8065aa5d08f1.webp)

A: Convex weld edge B: Weld reinforcement C: Weld root

b. Check the weld from the back for the following defects, and re-weld if necessary:

Component deformation Bad welding joint Too low plastic filling surface of welds

5. Re-machine the weld

a. After cooling, the convex part of the weld can be polished by an angle grinder. Sandpaper type: coarse sandpaper
b. Then grind the surface with a track grinder. Sandpaper type: fine sandpaper
c. Clean the repair surface with a plastic cleaning brush.
d. Spray plastic primer on the repair surface.

### 8.1.2.7 Plastic bonding

0 Tip:

It is applicable to thermoplastic parts and thermosetting plastic parts. All thermoplastic parts must use adhesives containing polyurethane. Reinforcing tapes can be used on welds and broken cracks to ensure initial ductility.

1. Clean the parts to be repaired

a. Before repair, clean both sides of plastic parts with a high-pressure water cleaner, and then dry them.
b. Clean the surface to be repaired with plastic cleaner.

2. Pretreatment of scratches:

![](images/4ca5778a147b3f53bee5f40ed30fd25a4078b5e04a4ec3083a319deb59eabf5d.webp)

a. ①: Preparation of scratch and crack.
b. ②: Preparation of crack parts.
c. Completely polish scratches or cracks with a track grinder and sandpaper. Sandpaper type: coarse sandpaper
d. Use a track grinder and sandpaper for fine grinding. Sandpaper type: fine sandpaper
e. Clean the repair surface with a plastic cleaner o paper towel thoroughly.

### 3. Pretreatment of cracks:

a. Grind the front side of the crack by using an angle grinder or belt grinder, with an grinding surface width of 40\~60mm.
b. Re-grind it with a track grinder. Sandpaper type: fine sandpaper
c. Drill holes with a 3mm drill bit at the end of cracks to prevent cracks from extending.
d. Grind it along the inner side of the crack.
e. Clean the parts to be repaired with a plastic cleaner or paper towel.

4. Scratch bonding

a. Fill the scratches with adhesive after cleaning and spraying primer.
b. Spread out and smooth the adhesive with a flexible plastic feeler gauge.
c. Dry it with an infrared heater or dryer.

5. Crack repair by bonding

0 Tip:

When cracks or crazing occur in large areas, the torsional strength can be improved by reinforcing the parts to be repaired. For this reason, appropriate reinforcement materials (such as metal strips and reinforcing fibers) are used to attach to the back of the parts.
a. Cover the front side of the crack with sheets of polyethylene material or tape.
b. Fill the weld with plastic adhesive from the inside.
c. Fill a wide reinforcing fiber into the weld together with the adhesive at the same time.
d. Reinforce the end of crack by attaching metal strips embedded on the plastic parts.
e. Trim the upper surface of the reinforcement material to the same height as the whole surface to be repaired.
f. Dry it with an infrared heater or dryer.
g. Prevent the adhesive from spilling from the front side of the crack with sheets of polyethylene material.
h. Take off sheets of polyethylene material after the adhesive is dried.
i. Apply adhesive to the front side of the part to be repaired.
j. Dry it with an infrared heater or dryer.
k. Cool the adhesive to room temperature to prevent the adhesive from falling off and the sandpaper from overheating during grinding.

### 6. Polishing

a. Polish off the protruding part of the adhesive with a track grinder.
Sandpaper type: coarse sandpaper b. Manually trim sunken and bent areas.
c. Rub the top coat with a grinding pad.
d. Clean plastic parts thoroughly.
e. Spray plastic primer after thorough drying.

### 1. Overview of health and safety precautions

a. Both appropriate maintenance methods and correct maintenance are extremely important for vehicle operation and personal safety. Therefore, it is necessary to know the possible dangerous situations in all workshops, be familiar with relevant standard operating procedures and safety precautions and operate in strict accordance with the standard procedures. During maintenance of the vehicle body, all clauses including work health and safety should be observed.

### 2. Important safety warnings about maintenance of vehicle body

A Warning: Be sure to wear protective clothing, goggles, gloves and work shoes when welding, cutting and grinding the body sheet metal. Before disassembling the whole vehicle components, be sure to fix the vehicle on the lifting bracket to avoid changes in the center of gravity of the vehicle, which will affect the operation safety. Do not weld, braze or solder any part of the A/C system containing refrigerant, and do not weld other parts of the vehicle that may cause the temperature of the A/C system parts to rise, otherwise the A/C system may be damaged. If the electric welding must be carried out near the refrigerant hose, the refrigerant must be recovered, because the invisible ultraviolet rays generated during the electric welding penetrate through the refrigerant hose, causing the refrigerant to decay. Be sure to disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) when operating the airbag system or correcting the vehicle body. The ambient temperature of airbag components should not exceed 100℃ (212℉).

3. Important safety precautions about maintenance of vehicle body

### i Caution:

The welding area must be well ventilated. Be sure to disconnect the anode and cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) and cover the terminals before welding. If there may be sparks when operating near the 12V battery (starter Fe battery), the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) must be removed. • An electronic system may be damaged by ultra-high voltage generated during welding and frame adjustment correction. Especially when welding the vehicle with the airbag system, be sure to follow safety instructions. Connect the ground wire of the electric welding device directly to the parts to be welded, and ensure that there is no conductive part between the grounding point and the welding point during operation. The ground wire or welding electrode should not be in contact with electronic control unit and wire. No unprotected vehicles should be parked in the maintenance area of the vehicle body, because the splashed sparks may cause fire and damage the top coat and glass. Be sure to disconnect the cathode of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) when operating the airbag system or correcting the vehicle body. The ambient temperature of airbag components should not exceed 100℃ (212℉). Do not weld the front anti-collision beam, which is designed to be fully functional only when it is in original shape. However, if the front anti-collision beam is repaired, its performance will be degraded.

### 4. Warnings about welding

A Warning: High voltage during electric welding: Do not perform welding operations in a humid environment or on a wet base plate. The base plate should use a suitable insulator. Flammable materials in the welding area: Remove flammable materials in the hazardous area. When welding in the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) area, the 12V battery (starter Fe battery) must be completely removed. Welding fume is harmful to health: Keep the working area well ventilated and use a welding fume extraction system. Welding spatter and UV radiation: Wear protective clothing, gloves and welding mask or welding goggles.

5. Important precautions about description of welding types

### i Caution:

Common welding types include spot welding, gas shielded welding and brazing.
Do not reduce the number of welding spots during spot welding.
Usually, when the spot welding device cannot be used, plug welding can be carried out by gas shielded welding after drilling.
When spot welding is used, if the three-layer plate is connected and only the outer plate is replaced, the welding spot must be placed on the original welding spot.
When spot welding is used, single-row weld, double-row weld and double-row offset weld can be generated.
When gas shielded welding is used, lap weld, continuous weld and continuous weld (intermittent) can be generated.
Brazing is often used to weld and repair areas with low tensile strength and small component thickness.

6. Warnings about chemical solvents

A Warning: When dealing with substances containing solvents, be sure to adopt good ventilation and wear the respiratory protective equipment. The impact of excessive exposure to chemicals on people may be direct or delayed, temporary or permanent, cumulative, and may endanger or shorten life.

7. Warnings about dust

！ Warning:

Powder, dust or smoke are mostly irritating, harmful or toxic. Therefore, it is necessary to try to avoid inhaling dust from powdery chemical materials or dry grinding operation. If the ventilation is insufficient, be sure to wear the respiratory protective equipment. The fine dust is combustible and has the risk of explosion. Be sure to avoid reaching the explosive concentration limit and keep away from the fire source.

### 8. Vehicle protection

a. During all welding and grinding operations on the vehicle, it is necessary to protect the affected areas from welding spatter and smoke. If metal dust falls on the vehicle for a certain time, film rust may be generated. Grinding or slinging operations will damage the paint surface, leaving tiny spots and leading to corrosion. Therefore, it should be ensured that: Protect the vehicle body with the carbon fiber blanket. Protect the vehicle body from sanded dust and metal dust with cover film.
b. When carrying out maintenance operation related to the interior of vehicle, be sure to adopt appropriate protective measures to protect the interior. Use carbon fiber blankets directly around the operation area, which provide maximum protection for the vehicle area. In addition, it should be considered that: Fire blankets should be provided to protect the working areas which are prone to fire. Be sure to avoid heating the A/C system components during welding. Remove all accessory components in the space near the maintenance area. In order to prevent the pollution of grinding smoke and dust, adopt cover paper to protect the interior of the vehicle, and set up a clear barrier between the working area and the interior of the vehicle with the carbon fiber blanket.

9. Environmental specification

a. Orderly and responsible waste management is not only very important for protecting health and environment, but also very important for saving natural resources.

### i Caution:

Be sure to follow the specific national disposal regulations in the operation of waste disposal.
Recyclable wastes that cannot be classified as domestic waste must be treated as special waste.
According to local requirements, all residual waste must be treated as commercial waste.

### 8.2.1.2 Maintenance materials after collision

1. In the collision accident of vehicle body, it will generally cause structural deformation, steel plate cracking, loose weld of welding spot and other phenomena, and sometimes causes partial damage to chassis and other assembled parts.
2. Adhesives, sealants, locking agents, surface protective materials and rust-proof materials may be used during maintenance of the vehicle body after collision. Please operate in strict accordance with the purpose, scope and specifications in the product manual.
3. Maintenance materials with the same functions should be selected according to the functional requirements of parts and materials in the process of vehicle body maintenance. ### 1. Removal

a. Remove all plates and parts related to the replaced parts.
b. Remove sealant and anti-corrosion materials if necessary.
c. Locate, mark and drill all factory welding spots connecting the parts to be replaced.
d. Disassemble the damaged parts to be replaced.
e. Remove residual materials.

### 2. Installation

a. Pre-treat the mating surface if necessary.
b. Choose the correct welding method according to the welding form of the original vehicle. Protective welding should be adopted if resistance welding is not inconvenient. If plug welding is selected, please drill holes on new parts for the welds of plug welding, and determine the diameter and interval of plug welding holes according to the original welding spots.
c. Temporarily put new parts on the vehicle.
d. Assemble and fix the new parts with the calibration support (position the maintenance plate correctly).
e. Frequently measure the position of new parts to ensure that their assembly dimensions are correct.
f. Perform the corresponding welding.
g. Clean all welding surfaces.
h. Spray the primer.
i. Spray sealant and anti-corrosion materials if necessary.
j. Install all relevant components.

### 8.2.2.2 Status of parts

1. Before the repaired vehicle or parts are sent to the paint shop for painting, the surface must be smooth and caulked, and be polished with sandpaper. This preparation process is completed by sheet metal workers.

2. The vehicle body and floor parts are mainly formed by cold stamping with steel plates, so the damaged part due to accident should be restored to its shape by the same method.

3. If the damaged part cannot be restored as it is, it is necessary to disassemble the damaged part and replace it according to the integrity of the parts after its adjacent parts are corrected.

4. Before replacing the key parts of the vehicle body, be sure to correct the vehicle body with a universal calibrated mount of the vehicle body, and then determine the damaged parts to be replaced.

5. Before welding, be sure to perform accurate positioning of the parts and measurement, so as to ensure that the parts meet the requirements of body size.

6. Be sure to know the welding and assembly relationship among body sheet metal parts before disassembly. It is not recommended to cut the parts individually. After cutting and welding, it will affect the rigidity, driving safety and maintenance convenience of the vehicle.

7. During welding, it is necessary to measure frequently to ensure correct assembly.

### 8.2.2.3 Description of welding types

1. Common welding types include spot welding, gas shielded welding and brazing.

2. Do not reduce the number of welding spots during spot welding.
3. When spot welding is used, if the three-layer plate is connected and only the outer plate is replaced, the welding spot must be placed on the original welding spot.
4. When spot welding is used, single-row weld, double-row weld and double-row offset weld can be generated.
5. Usually, when the spot welding device cannot be used, plug welding can be carried out by gas shielded welding after drilling.
6. When gas shielded welding is used, lap weld, continuous weld and continuous weld (intermittent) can be generated.
7. Brazing is often used to weld and repair areas with low tensile strength and small component thickness.

### 8.2.2.4 Anti-corrosion treatment

1. After maintenance, the standard anti-corrosion coat must be restored with approved materials.

2. Before sealing, the inner and outer sides of all welds must be primed.

3. The primed metal plate must be coated with sealant.

4. Overlapped sheet metal parts, metal edges and welds must be sealed with sealant.

5. The vehicle floor should be coated with long-lasting floor protective agent.

6. After spraying the top coat, the cavity in the maintenance area must be treated with cavity protective materials.

7. Clean the water outlet after the cavity protective materials are dried.

### 8.2.2.5 Vehicle waxing

It is necessary to carry out corresponding maintenance for the vehicle after sale in order to ensure continuous anti-corrosion of the vehicle.

1. When the vehicle reaches the required maintenance period, the following should be paid attention to in addition to routine maintenance:

a. It is recommended to regularly check the integrity of the wax layer at the bottom, and re-coat the damaged parts to prevent corrosion in case of any damage.
b. After vehicle maintenance and fastener disassembly, it is necessary to brush the fasteners with wax for anti-corrosion.
c. When replacing updated parts and fasteners, it is necessary to brush anti-corrosion wax accordingly.

2. Pay attention to avoid high-voltage wires, rubber bushings, electrical wiring harness connectors, battery high-voltage wire ports, etc. No wax can be attached.

3. Data collection: For each maintenance, it is necessary to take photos of all parts and collect corrosion information of the parts.

4. Type and technical requirements of wax used:

### 8.2.2.6 Environmental protection measures for automobile scrap parts

1. Be sure to collect the waste materials by type after maintenance or repair of the vehicle.
2. Classify the waste materials and check whether they can be reused.

### Replacement procedures

i Caution:

During welding, a fire may be caused easily if the splashing welding slag contacts wires, tapes, etc. Therefore, pay attention to similar places during welding, and do a good job of cleaning and protection in advance.
In addition to disconnecting the cathode cable of the 12V battery (starter Fe battery), overlap the ground wire of the electric welding machine near the welding site as closer as possible. During welding, disconnect all electronic control unit connectors to avoid damage to the electronic control unit.

1. Remove the rear door assembly and accessories around the rear fender
2. Replace the rear fender

![](images/b4ef8d8b4a740a9d6dd14c6b69bf3f8f0276731a3d8d68b60a011ee9da30ee4a.webp)

a. Drill the weld nuggets of the welding spot from the outer panel surface with an electric drill.

0 Tip:

The pink dots are the overlapping welding spots between the left side wall outer panel and the inner panel.

i Caution: Drill through two layers of panels.

![](images/792ccd3888b0d11ae6462b5296cb807ed9c7ef40dd066358bfc4b0dad9535656.webp)

![](images/20a45ac784776bf7026173ba66d4f8c10c6aa3c555172e736c892948de836b8e.webp)

b. After drilling welding spots, cut the position (outer panel surface of the pedal) of the red line indicated by the arrow to the other end indicated by the arrow from top to bottom from the outer panel surface with a cutting machine. Then cut the position (at the door frame) of the black line indicated by the arrow to the other end (beside the rear left tail light) indicated by the arrow from left to right from the outer panel surface with a cutting machine.

c. After cutting and removing the outer panel, polish the iron slag, burrs or bumps remaining on the body surface with a grinding machine.

d. After polishing, apply sealant first between the welding spots of the blue line as shown.

### i Caution:

The diameter of the sealant is 3mm\~5mm, and the hole cannot be blocked.

![](images/cf160d8e1f65dfbeb07a403d706ccc2c3e3802066bde224fc4d66b8e1908de86.webp)

e. After applying the sealant, cut the new left side wall assembly according to the method of cutting the left side wall outer panel on the body. The size cut from the outer panel of the new body should be equal to that cut from the outer panel of the original body.

![](images/e8aa10dd8c2b9af529a12d7f7858d72eaa4d4e1e136772f2e3526c5293b40d6d.webp)

f. After connecting the new parts, weld them on the outer panel surface by CO2 shielded arc welding from the position where the original welding spots indicated in the red frame has been drilled, and then weld the positions from the outer panel surface at the end of black line (beside the rear left tail light) indicated by the arrow to the other end (sill) indicated by red arrow from right to left. Parameter setting of CO2 shielded arc welding: current of arc welding: about 80A; voltage of arc welding: 15V; gas flow of arc welding: 15\~25L/ min; diameter of welding wire: 0.8mm

![](images/742209a8bde2413cac3f8fb90f2671a66c3a3b17033da1567506b99a5c59f09c.webp)

g. After welding, polish welding scars, welding slag and bumps on the outer panel surface caused by CO2 shielded arc welding, and then wax the surface and apply epoxy primer.

![](images/bc53651fe7118d4eb7bb2e2b162a0ec9f5b3ec5a3f9d0f2de78e1db583f6d85a.webp)

h. After treatment of the outer panel surface, apply epoxy primer to the welding position from the inner hole with a brush for anti-corrosion.

### 0 Tip:

The position where epoxy primer cannot be applied with a brush can be sprayed with the bottled epoxy primer for anti-corrosion.

3. Install the rear door assembly and accessories around the rear fender
